parts.title: Before You Start
parts.subtitle: How this guide works
intro: This part explains how to use the route, the game rules that matter for trophies, and the one habit that protects the platinum: staying honourable and keeping manual saves.
Nothing here is missable. Read it once, tick the steps, then start a new game.
Expect roughly 240-300 hours for the full platinum: about 50-60 hours of story, a long single-player clean-up, then Red Dead Online. The online part depends heavily on how you earn XP.

parts.title: Chapter 1
parts.subtitle: Colter
intro: Chapter 1 is a short, linear run through six story missions in the snowy mountains. There is no free roam worth doing here.
No trophy can be missed in this chapter. The only missables are two optional documents you can pick up during the train mission.
All six missions have gold medals. Save before each one. Expect about 2-3 hours.

parts.title: Chapter 2
parts.subtitle: Horseshoe Overlook
intro: Chapter 2 is the first open chapter. You start story missions from map icons whenever you like, and there is a lot of free roam. Go back to camp between missions: companion activities and item requests only happen there.

Missable here: the first Lending a Hand set (Money Lending I-III, We Loved Once and True I-III, Good, Honest, Snake Oil), a Chapter 2 companion activity for Friends With Benefits, and the Chapter-2-only item requests. Finish all of them before 'The Sheep and the Goats'. Start Give to the Poor and Errand Boy now too.

Nothing else here is truly missable, but this is the best time to begin challenges, rock carvings, homesteads, table games and several stranger missions. Arthur should stay out of New Austin, where bounty hunters kill him, and avoid Blackwater and Tall Trees to be safe.
Expect about 12-20 hours, depending on how much free roam you do.

parts.title: Chapter 3
parts.subtitle: Clemens Point
intro: Chapter 3 moves the gang to a new camp at Clemens Point, near Rhodes in Lemoyne. Like Chapter 2 it is an open chapter: you start story missions from map icons whenever you like, so there is plenty of time for side content between them.

Several things in this chapter are lost for good when it ends. You need one companion activity in this camp (Friends With Benefits), and several item requests only exist here (Errand Boy). The optional Honor missions The Course of True Love I-III and Money Lending and Other Sins IV all count towards Lending a Hand. A unique rifle can only be looted during 'Magicians for Sport'.

Guides disagree on exactly when the Chapter 3 extras disappear. The latest possible cut-off is 'Blood Feuds, Ancient and Modern'. One source says some go earlier, so this route clears everything before 'Blessed are the Peacemakers', which keeps you safe whichever source is right.

This chapter also opens four Stranger strands (they count towards Western Stranger). Return to camp during the day between missions to pick up activities and item requests. The whole story takes roughly 50-60 hours; Chapter 3 is one of the longer, free-roam-heavy chapters.

parts.title: Chapter 4
parts.subtitle: Saint Denis
intro: Chapter 4 moves the gang to a camp at Shady Belle and opens up the city of Saint Denis. It is the last chapter with the gang's camp extras, so its final mission, 'Banking, the Old American Art', is the biggest point of no return in the game.

Missable here: the Chapter 4 companion activity (this is when Friends With Benefits pops), the last chance for Errand Boy (5 item requests in total) and Give to the Poor ($250 in the tithing box), and five Honor mission parts for Lending a Hand: Help a Brother Out, Brothers and Sisters, One and All, Fatherhood and Other Dreams I and II, and Money Lending and Other Sins V. Brothers and Sisters also unlocks a Chapter 6 Honor mission, so skipping it costs you twice.

This chapter also opens seven Stranger strands. They include A Bright Bouncing Boy (Artificial Intelligence trophy) and Duchesses and other Animals (the exotics collection). Saint Denis also has the dominoes and poker you need for Hobby Horse.
Do the Honor missions and camp extras as soon as they appear, and leave the story finale for last. The whole story takes roughly 50-60 hours.

parts.title: Chapter 5
parts.subtitle: Guarma and the return to Lemoyne
intro: Chapter 5 is short: about 5-6 hours. It starts on the island of Guarma, where you have none of your usual gear, then returns you to the mainland for the last few missions before Chapter 6.

Nothing trophy-related is lost on Guarma. You can never go back to the island after 'Paradise Mercifully Departed', but its unique animals are not needed for Zoologist or Skin Deep. Studying them is optional.

Back on the mainland, check your Honor. The Chapter 6 honor missions need Honor level 4 of 8, so if you are below that, start raising it now. All 9 missions here have gold medals, and 'No Traitors' pops automatically at the end of the chapter.

parts.title: Chapter 6
parts.subtitle: Beaver Hollow
intro: Chapter 6 is the most important chapter for missables. It holds the final set of honor missions for Lending a Hand (silver), and they are lost when the chapter ends. Some sources say most of them are lost earlier, at 'The Fine Art of Conversation', so this route does all of them before that mission.

First job: get your Honor to at least level 4 of 8. 'Do Not Seek Absolution' will not start without it. Guides report that Honor gains are 50% faster in this chapter, which also makes it the best place to try for Extreme Personality (maximum Honor).

The chapter ends with two back-to-back missions. After them your cash and horses are gone (tap reveal on the warnings for why). Keep a manual save before the finale. Expect roughly 10-15 hours with all side content.

parts.title: Epilogue Part 1
parts.subtitle: Pronghorn Ranch
intro: The Epilogue starts straight after the Chapter 6 credits. Part 1 is ten short story missions around Pronghorn Ranch, Strawberry and Blackwater, plus one cutscene with no medal.
Nothing in Part 1 can lock you out of a trophy. The only missables are two cosmetic hats, noted in the first two missions.
Keep making a manual save before every mission and reload if a gold objective fails. Every mission can also be replayed for gold after the credits.
New Austin (Armadillo, Tumbleweed, Fort Mercer) is safe to explore from now on. Leave most of it for the post-story Cleanup part, which covers collectibles, animals and 100% in one efficient sweep.

parts.title: Epilogue Part 2
parts.subtitle: Beecher's Hope
intro: Part 2 is based at Beecher's Hope, west of Blackwater. It has eleven gold-medal missions and one cutscene with no medal.
Two story trophies unlock here automatically: Cowboy Builder (for 'A New Jerusalem') and Endless Summer (for finishing the Epilogue).
Nothing trophy-related can be lost in Part 2. The last Ms. Hobbs hunting request is now available, but hunting requests are handled in the Cleanup part.
Keep a manual save before each mission. After the final mission and the credits, the game returns you to free roam with every mission replayable.

parts.title: Post-Story Cleanup
parts.subtitle: Free roam after the credits
intro: The story is over and the whole map is open, New Austin included. This part is a checklist of free-roam sessions: catch-up for any trophy you skipped earlier, the New Austin sweep, the long grinds (animals, bears, bounties), gold medal replays and the 100% run for Best in the West.

Nothing in this part can be missed. The order below saves time: quick catch-ups first, then New Austin (it feeds several trackers at once), then the long grinds, and finally the crime spree for Bountiful and Extreme Personality from a backup save, so the drop in Honor never sticks.
Check Pause > Progress > Total Completion often. It shows exactly what is still missing for 100%. Expect this part to take roughly 100 hours or more, depending on how much you finished as Arthur.

parts.title: Red Dead Online
parts.subtitle: The 17 online trophies and the platinum
intro: This part covers all 17 Red Dead Online trophies (16 bronze, 1 gold), then the platinum. Online needs a PlayStation Plus subscription (except during occasional free-online promotions) and a working internet connection. It needs no Story Mode progress, so you can do it any time, even in parallel with the story. The trophies land on the same RDR2 list, so play Online through the full RDR2 game on the same account you use for Story Mode.

Server status as of this guide's research (1 October 2026): Red Dead Online is still live. Rockstar stopped big content updates in 2022 but still runs monthly bonus events (for example June to August 2026), and players were still earning every online trophy in 2025-2026. Series playlists rotate, so a mode named here may only be available in some weeks.

Most of the list can be done alone. Three trophies need other real players: Strength in Numbers (one posse mate), All's Fair (a rival player; easiest with a friend) and The Real Deal (a series lobby with at least 4 players). Budget about $2,150 in online dollars for Posse Up, Horses for Courses and Home Comforts.

Rough time: 40-100 hours, mostly the Rank 50 grind for Notorious. Nothing here is missable. Do the quick solo trophies first, then the multiplayer ones, then grind to Rank 50 while mopping up anything left over.

steps.title: Learn how the route works
how: Work top to bottom. Every step sits where it should be done; you never need to scroll back.
Tick each step when it's done. Mission steps list their gold-medal objectives underneath.
Long goals (collectibles, challenges, animals) live in trackers. A 'session' step tells you when to open a tracker and what to do in it.
Use the missables filter to see only steps with a cut-off. Each shows the mission after which it is lost.
A 'warning' step always comes just before a point-of-no-return mission. Don't start that mission until every item in the warning is ticked.
Text marked as a spoiler stays hidden until you tap reveal.

steps.title: Know the game rules that affect trophies
how: Story mode has no difficulty setting, so no trophy depends on difficulty.
Never enter a cheat code. Cheats disable saving and trophy progress.
Red Dead Redemption 2 is a PS4 game. On PS5 it runs through backward compatibility and uses the same PS4 trophy list.
There is no chapter select. Anything you miss in a chapter needs an older save or a new playthrough.
One playthrough is enough if you follow the warnings.
Completed story missions can be replayed after the story from Pause > Progress > Story to earn gold medals you missed. Replays use basic gear and no tonics, so they are harder.
Replaying an optional honor mission from the Story menu does NOT count towards Lending a Hand. Those must be done during the story.

steps.title: Set up a manual save habit
how: Make a manual save at the start of every chapter.
Make a manual save before every story mission on your first playthrough. All gold objectives for a mission must be met in one run, and checkpoint restarts reset the counters.
Keep a separate save before each point-of-no-return mission. The route reminds you with a warning step.
Save before any robbery or crime spree, so you can reload if it goes wrong or costs too much Honor.
steps.tip: Rotate between several save slots so an autosave never overwrites the save you'd need to go back to.

steps.title: Understand gold medals
how: Gold Rush needs gold medals in 70 of the 104 story missions that have them, so 34 can be skipped.
Try for gold on your first run, but don't restart a mission endlessly. Missed ones can be replayed after the story.
Timed objectives include cutscenes. Skip cutscenes to save time.
'No health items' objectives only ban health items. Dead Eye items are allowed.
Restart from the checkpoint as soon as you fail an objective.
steps.unverified: Sources count gold-medal missions differently: PowerPyx says 104, GTABase says 105. The 70 needed for the trophy is the same either way.

steps.title: Stay honourable for the whole story
how: Keep Arthur's Honor on the good (white) side from the very start.
You need at least Honor level 4 of 8 by Chapter 6, or one of the optional honor missions will not start and Lending a Hand is lost.
Greet people, help strangers you meet on the road, and hogtie rather than kill when you can.
Don't rob or kill random people. If you do something dishonourable by accident, reload.
Catching and releasing fish, and handing in bounties alive, are quick ways to raise Honor.
Leave Extreme Personality (maximum Honor) for Chapter 6 or later. The top Honor level is locked until late in the story.
steps.unverified: Guides describe the Chapter 6 requirement as 'level 4 of 8', 'halfway into the white' or just 'high honor'. These mean the same thing, but aim higher to be safe.

steps.title: Know the four missable trophies
how: Lending a Hand: every optional honor mission in Chapters 2, 3, 4 and 6. Each set is lost when its chapter ends.
Friends With Benefits: one companion activity in each of the Chapter 2, 3 and 4 camps.
Give to the Poor: donate $250 to the camp tithing box before Chapter 4 ends.
Errand Boy: deliver 5 item requests to gang members before Chapter 4 ends.
The route puts each of these well before its deadline.
steps.unverified: One guide (GamerGuides) also treats Breaking and Entering as missable, because homesteads can be lost. The route does it in Chapter 2 to be safe.

steps.title: Plan your time
how: Stage 1, story (about 50-60 hours): handle the missables, do every optional honor mission, stay honourable, try for gold medals and start challenges.
Stage 2, after the story: collectibles, all 90 challenges, graves, stranger missions and gold-medal replays.
Stage 3: study and skin the animals for Zoologist and Skin Deep.
Stage 4, Red Dead Online to rank 50. It needs PlayStation Plus and can be done at any time.
steps.unverified: Red Dead Online servers were reported as working in late September 2026, with no shutdown announced. Check again before relying on the online trophies.

steps.title: Play 'Outlaws from the West'
steps.where: Colter camp, Grizzlies (the story starts here)
how: Start a new game. The mission begins automatically.
Search every cupboard, drawer, nightstand and the loft for loot before you leave the ranch.
gold: Take no damage during the shootout
Loot 6 or more items from Adler Ranch
Complete with at least 80% accuracy
goldTips: Fight from cover and pop out only to fire; six enemies total, including one in an upstairs window and one coming from the outhouse.
Search cupboards, nightstands, drawers and the loft for loot before leaving the ranch.
Make a manual save before the mission so you can retry; all objectives must be done in one run.

steps.title: Play 'Enter, Pursued by a Memory'
how: Start it from the mission marker at Colter camp after the first mission.
When the wolves attack, stay on high rocks and use Dead Eye to protect your accuracy.
gold: Kill all the wolves without taking any damage
Complete with at least 80% accuracy
goldTips: Wolves come in two waves (a few on foot, more while riding); stay on high rocks and shoot them as they approach.
Use Dead Eye to keep accuracy high; misses on the move ruin the 80%.
steps.unverified: The trophy research says Just a Scratch pops on finishing 'Enter, Pursued by a Memory' but labels that mission as Chapter 2. Mission research puts it in Chapter 1. It is counted here, and the trophy should pop when this mission ends.

steps.title: Play 'The Aftermath of Genesis'
how: Start it from the mission marker at Colter camp.
Crouch and approach the deer slowly. Check the wind direction so they can't smell you.
gold: Kill each deer with one arrow
Do not spook either deer
Get a clean kill on the second deer
goldTips: Crouch and approach slowly; check wind direction with Eagle Eye so the deer do not smell you.
Use Dead Eye and aim at the head/heart so each arrow is a one-shot, clean kill.

steps.title: Play 'Old Friends'
how: Start it from the mission marker at Colter camp.
Equip the lasso before the chase so you can react at once.
Don't use any health items during the mission. Dead Eye items are fine.
gold: Catch and hogtie Kieran within 45 seconds
Kill 3 O'Driscolls in the same Dead Eye use
Complete within 15 minutes 30 seconds
Get 15 headshots
Complete the mission without taking any health items
goldTips: Equip the lasso and sprint immediately when the chase begins.
Play aggressively rather than stealthily to save time; use Dead Eye on groups to get the triple kill and headshots.
Dead Eye restoratives are allowed; only health items are forbidden.

steps.title: Save before the train mission
how: Make a manual save now.
The next mission contains two documents that can only be picked up during it: 'Mining Company Letter to Cornwall' and 'Oil Company Letter to Cornwall'.
They are for compendium completeness only. No trophy needs them, so don't reload just for these.

missable.deadline: during 'Who the Hell is Leviticus Cornwall?'

steps.unverified: Only one source (the Codeberg missables checklist) lists these two documents as missable. The research does not say exactly where in the train they are.

steps.title: Play 'Who the Hell is Leviticus Cornwall?'
how: Start it from the mission marker at Colter camp.
After the shootout, search the train cars and pick up both Cornwall letters before you leave.
Don't use any health items during the mission.
gold: Save Lenny when he is hanging from the train
After stopping the train, take out the guards within 1 minute 30 seconds
Take no damage during the shootout
Get 10 headshots
Complete the mission without taking any health items
goldTips: Stay in cover and use Dead Eye constantly for the headshots and the timed guard fight.
Prioritise guards who climb or flank to avoid taking damage.

missable.deadline: the two Cornwall letters are lost when this mission ends

steps.unverified: Only one source lists the Cornwall letters, and it gives no exact location inside the train.

steps.title: Save before leaving the mountains
how: Make a manual save now, in a slot you will keep.
The next mission ends Chapter 1 and you can't return to Colter camp during the story.
Nothing trophy-related is lost here. If you skipped the Cornwall letters during the train mission, they are already gone. That doesn't matter for trophies.
steps.unverified: Sources disagree on which mission closes Chapter 1. The mission research marks 'Eastward Bound' as the point of no return, while the missables research names 'Who the Hell is Leviticus Cornwall?'. There are no trophy missables in Chapter 1 either way.

steps.title: Play 'Eastward Bound'
how: Start it from the mission marker at Colter camp.
Skip cutscenes and keep the wagon at full speed. This mission is timed.
Chapter 1 ends when the mission is over.
gold: Pick up Javier when entering Horseshoe Overlook
Complete within 6 minutes
goldTips: Fix the wagon wheel quickly, skip cutscenes and keep the wagon/horse at speed the whole way.

steps.title: Know how Chapter 2 works
how: Missions start from icons on the map. The order below is a recommendation, except that 'The Sheep and the Goats' and then 'A Strange Kindness' end the chapter.
Go back to Horseshoe Overlook camp between missions, in daytime (roughly 08:00-20:00). That's when gang members offer activities and ask for items.
If a companion prompt doesn't appear, do a story mission or sleep in your tent, then check camp again.
Stay out of New Austin (far south-west) for now: bounty hunters kill Arthur there. Avoid Blackwater and Tall Trees as well.
steps.unverified: Guides list Chapter 2 missions in different orders; only the chapter's final two missions are fixed. That Arthur is shot on sight in Blackwater is disputed (PowerPyx says yes; a Fandom summary says almost everything is doable as Arthur). Avoid it to be safe. The Tall Trees danger (a sniper) is only mentioned by Game Rant in the fishing research.

steps.title: Play 'Polite Society, Valentine Style'
how: This mission opens Chapter 2. Start it at camp.
When the stranded wagon owner asks for help, bring back the loose horse.
gold: Return the lost wagon horse to its owner
Find Karen within 45 seconds
goldTips: Help the stranded wagon owner by bringing back the loose horse when the prompt appears.
When the girls need finding, move straight to the objective (alley, then hotel) without detours.

steps.title: Pick one horse and bond with it
how: Choose the horse you'll ride for the rest of the story and always ride that one.
Pat it, brush it and feed it regularly, and calm it when it's scared.
Keep going until the Horse screen shows bonding level 4.
steps.tip: Level 4 bonding is also part of 100% completion, so this does double duty.

steps.title: Donate $250 to the camp tithing box
how: Walk to the tithing box in camp and interact with it.
Donate cash. Your donations add up across visits.
Keep donating from story payouts until your own total reaches $250. Gang members' donations don't count.
Tick this step when the trophy pops.

missable.deadline: before finishing 'Banking, the Old American Art' (end of Chapter 4)

steps.unverified: PowerPyx says donated valuables also count towards the $250. Other guides recommend plain cash because it's tracked reliably. Donate cash to be safe.

steps.title: Play 'Americans at Rest'
how: Start it at the mission icon in Valentine.
React at once when Javier is threatened.
In the fistfight, block and counter rather than trading blows.
gold: Save Javier within 15 seconds
Defeat Tommy within 1 minute 30 seconds
goldTips: React immediately when Javier is held up.
In the fistfight, block and counter-attack rather than trading blows.

steps.title: Play 'Exit Pursued by a Bruised Ego'
how: Start it from Hosea's icon at camp.
Skip cutscenes and do the crafting and cooking steps quickly. The mission is timed.
This mission unlocks most legendary animals. You don't need to hunt the legendary bear it introduces now; it stays huntable in free roam.
gold: Track the bear within 1 minute 30 seconds
Shoot the bear at least 6 times
Complete within 12 minutes
goldTips: Skip cutscenes and do the crafting/cooking steps quickly.
Use Dead Eye on the bear to land the 6 hits before it goes down.
steps.unverified: rdr2.org lists only two gold objectives for this mission; PowerPyx, Hold To Reset and GamesHedge list three, including tracking the bear within 1:30. Aim for all three.

steps.title: Do a companion activity with Charles
how: Go back to camp in daytime and talk to Charles.
Accept his hunting outing and finish it.
If he doesn't offer it, do another story mission or sleep in your tent, then try again.
Javier's home robbery in Valentine also counts, but it costs Honor. Prefer the hunt.
Don't rely on table games with gang members (five finger fillet, dominoes). They may not count.
steps.tip: You need one activity in each of the Chapter 2, 3 and 4 camps. Doing extra in Chapter 2 does not make up for a missed later chapter.

missable.deadline: before starting 'The Sheep and the Goats'

steps.unverified: Guides disagree on whether finished camp table games (such as Lenny's five finger fillet) count. PowerPyx and DamnModz say they don't; one search-summary source says they do. Guides also disagree on whether Javier's Chapter 2 home robbery can still be done in Chapter 3. Do Charles's hunt in Chapter 2 to be safe. The research says the hunt is for bison but that detail comes from one source.

steps.title: Deliver camp item requests
how: Spend some daytime (08:00-20:00) in camp and talk to gang members. Some will ask for an item.
Do the Chapter-2-only requests first: Abigail wants $5, Jack a comic book and a thimble, Javier Oleander Sage, Mary-Beth a fountain pen, Sean Kentucky Bourbon, Pearson an unskinned rabbit.
Buy Kentucky Bourbon (Sean) or Pomade (Bill) at a General Store. Buy Moonshine for Charles at a Fence.
Mary-Beth's fountain pen is on a nightstand at Osman Grove, east of Emerald Ranch.
Hand each item over by talking to the person who asked.
Deliver 5 in total. Chapters 3 and 4 give more chances, but finish in Chapter 2 if you can.
steps.tip: Requests are random and appear more often after you've done a story mission with that person.

missable.deadline: Chapter 2 requests: before 'The Sheep and the Goats'. Trophy: before finishing 'Banking, the Old American Art'

steps.unverified: One source (the Red Dead Wiki, via search summary) says item requests also appear in the Epilogue. Other guides say Chapters 2-4 only. Treat the end of Chapter 4 as the hard deadline.

steps.title: Play 'Paying a Social Call'
how: Start it from the mission icon at camp.
Use the bow, throwing knives or takedowns for the silent kills before the shooting starts.
Don't use any health items during the mission.
gold: Silently kill 4 O'Driscolls
Get 12 headshots
Complete with at least 80% accuracy
Complete the mission without taking any health items
goldTips: Use the bow, throwing knives or melee takedowns for the silent kills before the shooting starts.
Use Dead Eye liberally for headshots and accuracy.

steps.title: Start the challenges
how: Open Pause > Progress > Challenges. There are 9 categories of 10.
Open the Challenges tracker and work on the first few of each category as you play.
Each challenge only unlocks when the previous one in its category is done. Progress made before a challenge unlocks doesn't count.
Throwing knives are now available, which some Weapons Expert and Herbalist challenges need.
Leave anything that needs New Austin or Blackwater for the Epilogue.
steps.tip: Nothing here is missable. All 90 challenges are needed for 100%, so every one you finish now saves time later.
steps.unverified: A Steam guide estimates 83 of 90 challenges are possible in Chapter 2; this is single-source. The mission that unlocks tomahawks is disputed.

steps.title: Play 'A Quiet Time'
how: Start it from the mission icon at camp.
During the drinking, find Tommy in the saloon and talk to him several times.
At the end, flee Valentine instead of fighting the lawmen.
gold: Try to make amends with an old rival
Catch Lenny in the act
Don't get arrested
goldTips: During the drinking section, seek out Tommy in the saloon and interact with him repeatedly.
At the end, flee the lawmen and leave Valentine instead of fighting them.
steps.unverified: rdr2.org describes 'make amends' as talking to Tommy four times; other sources just say 'make amends'.

steps.title: Play 'Who is Not without Sin'
before: A Horse Stimulant in your satchel
how: Start it from Reverend Swanson's mission icon.
After the poker tutorial, keep playing until you've won two hands.
Take a Horse Stimulant for the timed ride back to camp.
gold: Win 2 hands of Poker
Return the Reverend to camp within 2 minutes 5 seconds
goldTips: Keep playing after the poker tutorial until you have won two hands.
Carry a Horse Stimulant for the timed ride back to camp.
steps.unverified: rdr2.org places the start near Flatneck Station; this wasn't cross-checked. Whether the poker in this mission counts for Hobby Horse isn't stated in the research; check Pause > Progress > Total Completion > Table Games afterwards.

steps.title: Accept the cigarette card collector's quest
how: Ride to Flatneck Station and talk to Phineas T. Ramsbottom to start 'Smoking and other Hobbies'.
Accept it now even if you won't collect cards yet. About one card per set only appears in the world once the quest is accepted.
Don't sell any card you still need. You mail physical cards, so keep them.
You only need one complete set of 12 for 100%. All 144 are only for Collector's Item, and rock carvings are a faster way to get that trophy.

steps.title: Buy the first treasure map
steps.where: Treasure hunter Maximo, on a ridge by the river west of Flatneck Station
how: Find Maximo Cristobal Valdespino west of Flatneck Station (south-west of Horseshoe Overlook).
Turn down his first price of $10; he drops it to $5. Buy the Jack Hall Gang map.
Picking up the map completes Explorer challenge 1.
Open the Treasure Hunts tracker to follow the map. Its clues are at Caliban's Seat, Cotorra Springs and O'Creagh's Run.
If you lose the map, buy another from a Fence.
steps.tip: This strand does not count for Western Stranger, but it covers the one treasure hunt 100% needs.

steps.title: Play 'The Spines of America'
how: Start it from Hosea's mission icon. It is done at night.
Search every drawer, chest and surface in the house.
On the way back, follow the marked road without stopping.
gold: Loot everything from Carmody Dell
Don't get spotted
Deliver the wagon to Emerald Ranch within 1 minute 10 seconds
goldTips: Go at night; search every drawer, chest and surface in the house.
On the return, follow the marked road without stopping.

steps.title: Collect Strauss's debts (Money Lending I & II)
steps.missionName: Money Lending and Other Sins - I & II
how: Talk to Leopold Strauss in camp to get the debt-collection jobs.
Visit every debtor on his list, not just one. The story only needs one, but guides say all of them must be done for Lending a Hand.
There is no gold medal for this part.
goldTips: No gold medal for this mission part; only one debtor needs to be collected to progress.

missable.deadline: before starting 'The Sheep and the Goats'

steps.unverified: The mission research says collecting one debtor is enough to move on; the missables research says every collection task must be done for Lending a Hand. Collect them all.

steps.title: Play 'Money Lending and Other Sins III'
how: Start it from the mission icon at camp once it appears.
Skip cutscenes and ride hard. The gold medal is only a time limit.
gold: Complete within 2 minutes 10 seconds
goldTips: Skip cutscenes and ride hard; this is purely a speed objective.

missable.deadline: before starting 'The Sheep and the Goats'

steps.title: Play 'Blessed are the Meek?'
before: Dead Eye items (no health items allowed)
how: Start it from Dutch's mission icon at camp.
Use Dead Eye throughout. Refill Dead Eye, not health.
During the escape on horseback, headshot the mounted lawmen quickly in Dead Eye.
gold: While escaping, kill all mounted Lawmen within 55 seconds
Get 15 headshots
Complete with at least 70% accuracy
Complete the mission without taking any health items
goldTips: Use Dead Eye throughout; restore Dead Eye (not health) with items if needed.
During the horseback escape, headshot the pursuing lawmen quickly in Dead Eye to beat 55 seconds.
steps.unverified: GamesHedge gives the accuracy objective as 75%; PowerPyx, Hold To Reset and rdr2.org say 70%. Aim above 75%.

steps.title: Play 'The First Shall Be Last'
before: Throwing knives if you have them
how: Start it from Javier's mission icon.
Use throwing knives or stealth takedowns for the two men by the river.
In the firefight, shoot the sniper on the water tower first.
Don't use any health items during the mission.
gold: Silently kill the Bounty Hunters by the river with Javier
Shoot the rope to free Sean
Get 10 headshots
Complete the mission without taking any health items
goldTips: Use throwing knives or stealth takedowns for the two riverside hunters.
In the firefight, take out the sniper on the water tower first; use Dead Eye for headshots and the rope shot.

steps.title: Play 'An American Pastoral Scene'
how: Look for this mission's icon after 'Blessed are the Meek?'. It may take several in-game hours to appear.
If it's there, do it now. If it isn't, carry on; it will then appear after 'The Sheep and the Goats'.
Use Dead Eye on every mounted guard and skip cutscenes. There's a time limit.
Don't use any health items during the mission.
gold: Headshot each of the mounted guards protecting the wagon
Get 10 kills in Dead Eye
Complete within 6 minutes
Complete the mission without taking any health items
goldTips: Use Dead Eye for every mounted guard; skip cutscenes to stay under 6 minutes.
steps.unverified: The research lists this mission after 'The Sheep and the Goats' (PowerPyx order). PowerPyx's own walkthrough page says it unlocks after 'Blessed are the Meek?' and is given by Micah, and a search summary says it appears about 12 in-game hours later. Some player reports say it may not unlock if 'The Sheep and the Goats' comes first. Doing it before the finale avoids that risk.

steps.title: Play 'Pouring Forth Oil I'
how: Start it from John's mission icon. It's a short conversation that sets up part II.
There is no gold medal for this part.
goldTips: No gold medal for part I (it is just the conversation that sets up part II).
steps.unverified: Only PowerPyx confirms that this part has no gold medal.

steps.title: Play 'Pouring Forth Oil II'
how: Start it from John's mission icon.
Kill pursuers quickly and keep the wagon at full speed on the road.
Don't leave it sitting once it is available: the wiki reports the mission is skipped if left active for about 4 in-game hours. It is NOT an honor mission and does not count for Lending a Hand.
gold: Deliver the wagon to the drop off within 1 minute 45 seconds
goldTips: Take the wagon at night, kill pursuers quickly and keep the wagon at full speed on the road.

missable.deadline: before starting 'The Sheep and the Goats'

steps.unverified: Not an honor mission (PowerPyx and the Red Dead Wiki's Lending a Hand list both leave it out; a fact-check confirmed this). The 4-hour skip is from the Red Dead Wiki only.

steps.title: Play 'A Fisher of Men'
how: Start it from Abigail's mission icon.
Skip cutscenes. At the river, cast at once towards splashes in the water.
There's no combat in this mission.
gold: After arriving at the river, catch a fish within 1 minute 30 seconds
Complete within 7 minutes 20 seconds
goldTips: Skip cutscenes; cast straight away toward splashes in the water. No combat in this mission.

steps.title: Play 'Pouring Forth Oil III'
how: Start it from the mission icon once it appears. It prepares the train job.
There is no separate gold medal listed for this part.
goldTips: No separate gold medal listed for part III (PowerPyx lists only II and IV).
steps.unverified: Only PowerPyx covers this part; it lists gold medals for parts II and IV only.

steps.title: Play 'Pouring Forth Oil IV'
before: Dead Eye items (no health items allowed)
how: Start it from the mission icon.
Move fast at the start so the guards are dead before Sean fires.
Clear the baggage car: cabinets behind the left door, the right-hand shelf, the green cabinet, the cabinet above the mail bags and the chest by the back door.
Change cover when the second wave of guards arrives.
gold: Kill all the train guards before Sean fires a shot
Clear the baggage car of loot
Escape the Law within 1 minute 30 seconds
Get 10 kills in Dead Eye
Complete the mission without taking any health items
goldTips: Move fast at the start so the guards are dead before Sean shoots.
Baggage car loot spots include cabinets behind the left door, a right-hand shelf, a green cabinet, a cabinet above the mail bags and a chest near the back door.
Change cover when the second guard wave arrives; use Dead Eye for the 10 Dead Eye kills.

steps.title: Read the letter in Arthur's tent (We Loved Once I & II)
steps.missionName: We Loved Once and True - I & II
steps.where: Arthur's tent at Horseshoe Overlook camp, then the Valentine area
how: Check Arthur's tent for a letter. Read it to start 'We Loved Once and True'.
The letter may arrive earlier than this point. Start it as soon as it's there.
Play parts I and II. They have no gold medals, but you need them to reach part III.
goldTips: No gold medal for parts I and II; only part III has objectives.

missable.deadline: before starting 'The Sheep and the Goats'

steps.title: Play 'We Loved Once and True III'
before: A Horse Stimulant in your satchel
how: Start part III when it's offered.
Stay peaceful the whole way through.
When talking to the group's leader, answer 'Undecided', then 'Purpose'.
If a gun is drawn, shoot the gun out of his hand. Don't shoot the person.
Use a Horse Stimulant for the timed ride back to Valentine station.
gold: Peacefully convince the Chelonians to let you take Jamie
Return Jamie to Mary within 2 minutes
goldTips: Do not use violence; per rdr2.org answer the leader's questions with 'Undecided' then 'Purpose', and shoot the gun out of Jamie's hand rather than him.
Use a Horse Stimulant for the 2-minute ride back to Valentine station.

missable.deadline: before starting 'The Sheep and the Goats'

steps.unverified: The dialogue answers come from rdr2.org only.

steps.title: Take the bounty from the Valentine sheriff
before: A Horse Stimulant in your satchel
how: Go to the Valentine Sheriff's Office and start 'Good, Honest, Snake Oil'.
Approach the target calmly and act promptly. He doesn't run at first, so there's no need to sneak.
Hogtie him. Don't kill him.
Use a Horse Stimulant for the timed return to the sheriff.
gold: Stop Benedict Allbright falling off the cliff
Hogtie Allbright within 1 minute 15 seconds
Return Allbright to the sheriff within 1 minute 30 seconds
goldTips: Allbright does not run at first, so no sneaking is needed; approach and act promptly.
Use a Horse Stimulant for the timed return.

missable.deadline: before starting 'The Sheep and the Goats'

steps.unverified: Codeberg says this mission stays available until the end of Chapter 5; PowerPyx treats it as a Chapter 2 mission. Do it now.

steps.title: Check the Chapter 2 honor missions are done
how: Open Pause > Progress > Story.
Confirm these are complete: Money Lending and Other Sins III, We Loved Once and True I-III, Good, Honest, Snake Oil.
Money Lending I and II aren't listed in the log. Make sure you visited every debtor Strauss gave you.
If any yellow honor-mission icon is still on the map, do it now.

missable.deadline: before starting 'The Sheep and the Goats'

steps.title: Buy every upgrade for one gun
before: Some cash for one set of component changes on one gun
how: Make a manual save outside the gunsmith.
Go to Customize and pick one gun you own, for example the Double-Action Revolver (PowerPyx's example) or the Cattleman.
Change each component slot once: grip, barrel length, barrel rifling and sights. You don't need every variant of a slot.
When Locked and Loaded pops, you can reload the save to get your money back.
steps.tip: Pony Up needs $5,000 of shop spending in total. If you have the cash, keep shopping before you reload. Trophies you earn stay earned after the reload.
steps.unverified: The research doesn't give component prices. If you can't afford everything yet, do this later in the story.

steps.title: Play the table games you can reach
how: Open the Hobby Horse tracker. You need to play one game each of Poker, Blackjack, Dominoes and Five Finger Fillet. You don't need to win.
Five Finger Fillet: Valentine, Strawberry or Van Horn.
Blackjack: the Rhodes saloon or Van Horn.
Poker: Valentine or Flatneck Station, if the story poker didn't count.
Dominoes is in Saint Denis. The route covers it in Chapter 4.
Check Pause > Progress > Total Completion > Table Games to confirm each one.
steps.tip: Poker and Blackjack wins also count towards the Gambler challenges.
steps.unverified: GamerGuides also lists blackjack in Saint Denis and Blackwater; no other source confirms it. Use Rhodes or Van Horn.

steps.title: Meet the rock carving collector
steps.where: Hut north-west of Strawberry, north-east of Owanjila Dam, Big Valley (Francis Sinclair)
how: Ride to the hut north-west of Strawberry and talk to Francis Sinclair to start 'Geology for Beginners'.
Do this before hunting carvings. Only 9 of the 10 can be recorded until you've met him.

steps.title: Find all 10 rock carvings
how: Open the Rock Carvings tracker and collect all 10. They are spread across the Grizzlies, New Hanover and West Elizabeth, and all are reachable as Arthur.
Mail the map at any post office once all 10 are recorded.
Wait about 2 in-game days, then go back to Sinclair's hut to finish the strand.
After the final cutscene, go back into the hut and take the Old Brass Compass from the table before you leave.
steps.tip: This is the fastest way to earn Collector's Item, and the strand is needed for 100% anyway. Don't leave Sinclair's hut after the final cutscene without the Old Brass Compass on the table (a talisman material, not needed for any trophy): the hut may lock afterwards.
steps.unverified: PowerPyx says the hut locks after the finale. The wiki says a reload trick or patch may reopen it. The compass is a talisman material and no trophy needs it.

steps.title: Meet the dinosaur bone collector
steps.where: The Heartlands, south-east of Horseshoe Overlook, north-east of Flatneck Station (Deborah MacGuiness)
how: Find Deborah MacGuiness in the Heartlands and start 'A Test of Faith'.
Start it now. The 30th bone can't be recorded until you've met her.
Collect any bones you pass using the Dinosaur Bones tracker, but don't go looking for the 8 in New Austin as Arthur.
You can only finish this strand in the Epilogue.

steps.title: Start 'The Noblest of Men, and a Woman'
how: Look for the stranger icon at Keane's Saloon in Valentine and start the strand.
Do the parts available now. The rest opens in Chapter 4.
After each duel, pick up the gunslinger's unique revolver. It can't be picked up later.
steps.tip: Not missable. It can be finished after the story, but doing it as Arthur keeps your options open.
steps.unverified: The start location and 'part 2 needs Chapter 4' come from Game Rant only; they aren't in the research files.

steps.title: Start 'The Smell of the Grease Paint'
steps.where: Old Light Saloon, Van Horn Trading Post
how: Look for the stranger icon at the Old Light Saloon in Van Horn and start the strand.
Do every part that's available now.
steps.tip: Not missable. It can be finished after the story.
steps.unverified: The start location comes from Game Rant only; it isn't in the research files.

steps.title: Start 'Arcadia for Amateurs'
steps.where: West of Riggs Station, West Elizabeth
how: Look for the stranger icon west of Riggs Station and start the strand.
Do every part that's available now. Later parts open over time.
steps.tip: The Codeberg checklist says the third part is Arthur-only (lost when Chapter 6 ends). Western Stranger has plenty of spare strands, but finishing it as Arthur keeps the buffer.
steps.unverified: The start location comes from Game Rant only.

steps.title: Start 'American Dreams'
how: Look for the stranger icon south-east of Valentine and start the strand.
Follow the clues it gives you. The strand has several parts.
steps.tip: Not missable. It can be finished after the story.
steps.unverified: The start location and 'several parts' come from Game Rant only. Game Rant says some finds are needed before the strand opens up.

steps.title: Trigger 'A Fine Night For It'
steps.where: South of Bluewater Marsh, Lemoyne, at night
how: Ride south of Bluewater Marsh at night, roughly 22:00 to 04:00.
Wait for the random encounter that starts the strand, then follow it.
steps.tip: Not missable. If it doesn't trigger, try again another night or leave it for later.
steps.unverified: The start area and time window come from Game Rant only; they aren't in the research files.

steps.title: Start the Ms. Hobbs hunting requests
steps.missionName: A Better World, A New Friend
steps.where: Hunting request posters at post offices / train stations (Valentine, Rhodes, Strawberry, Van Horn)
how: Look for a hunting request poster at the post office or station in Valentine, Rhodes, Strawberry or Van Horn.
Each request asks for perfect animal carcasses, mailed to Ms. L. Hobbs from a post office.
Do the four requests that are available before the Epilogue. The fifth only appears in the Epilogue.
If no poster is up yet, do this early in Chapter 3 instead.
steps.tip: All 5 requests are needed for 100% and lead to the It's Art trophy after the story.
steps.unverified: The research says the first four requests are available from Chapter 2. GTABase (via search summary) says this strand only opens after Chapter 2 ends. Whether it counts for Western Stranger isn't stated by PowerPyx, so don't count on it for that trophy. Poster towns come from web search, not the research.

steps.title: Do the 'Fundraiser' stranger mission (optional)
steps.where: North-west Saint Denis, near the tailor
how: When you first visit Saint Denis, look for the woman collecting donations near the tailor.
Talk to her and finish the mission. If Saint Denis isn't open to you yet, do it when it is.
Tick this whenever it's done, up to the end of Chapter 6.
steps.tip: No trophy needs this. It doesn't count for Western Stranger and is only available until Chapter 6.
steps.unverified: The research files list Fundraiser as a Chapter 2 stranger. GTABase (via search summary) says it only opens after Chapter 2 and puts it in Saint Denis. Its location isn't in the research files.

steps.title: Rob 4 homestead stashes
how: Open the Homesteads tracker. You need 4 of the 7 stashes.
Make a manual save before each one.
Put your bandana on before robbing. It reduces Honor loss.
Loot everything at the homestead, not just the stash. Otherwise the trophy counter may not register it.
Never kill the owners of a homestead you haven't robbed yet. That can close it for good.

Do NOT rob Catfish Jackson's, and don't knock out or kill Algie or Nate Davison, before you have finished Money Lending V in Chapter 4: that can cancel the debt, and Money Lending V is needed for Lending a Hand.
Skip Willard's Rest (Chapter 6 or later) and the Van Horn mansion for now. Choose from the others.
If a robbery goes wrong or costs too much Honor, reload.
steps.unverified: Most guides say this trophy isn't missable; GamerGuides treats it as missable and recommends Chapters 2-3. The research doesn't confirm which homesteads can be robbed in Chapter 2, only that the trophy is possible from Chapter 2.

steps.title: Hunt legendary animals if you like
how: Open the Legendary Animals tracker. Most of them are available now.
Go to a legendary map icon and wait for the 'Legendary Animal Territory' prompt before looking for clues.
Skin every legendary you kill. Each one spawns only once per save.
Skip the three in New Austin, the Bullgator (later chapter) and the Giaguaro Panther (needs Master Hunter 9).
Wear cold-weather clothing for the Grizzlies (for example the White Bison at Lake Isabella).
steps.tip: No trophy needs these directly. 100% needs any 5 legendary kills, and legendary pelts give trapper outfits.

steps.title: Craft many different items
how: Self Sufficient needs 30 different item types crafted, not 30 crafts in total.
Craft a variety as you play: ammo types, tonics, cooked meats, horse items and arrows.
Improved, fire and small game arrows can already be crafted. Dynamite and poison arrows need pamphlets from a Fence.

steps.title: Let two trophies come naturally
how: Take From the Rich: loot the bodies of enemies you kill in missions. The cash adds up to $250 on its own.
Pony Up: $5,000 of shop spending in total. It builds up from gunsmith, stable, general store and tailor purchases.
If Pony Up hasn't popped by the late story, save, spend on anything, then reload.

steps.title: Grab the Chapter 2 documents (optional)
how: Dutch's Speech Notes: near the broken wagon at Horseshoe Overlook.
Charity Handbill: on Thomas Downes's table.
Antique Watch: in a drawer in Wrobel's house.
steps.tip: For compendium completeness only. No trophy needs these.

'Do a companion activity with Charles' (Friends With Benefits, Chapter 2).
'Deliver camp item requests': hand in any Chapter-2-only request you're holding.
'Donate $250 to the camp tithing box': not lost yet (deadline Chapter 4), but finish it now if you can.
Do the 'An American Pastoral Scene' step if its icon is already on the map.
'Grab the Chapter 2 documents (optional)' if you want them.
Make a manual save now, in a slot you will keep.
steps.unverified: Codeberg names 'The Sheep and the Goats' as the cut-off for Chapter 2 missables. Other sources say only 'end of Chapter 2' (after 'A Strange Kindness'). The earlier deadline is used here to be safe.

steps.title: Play 'The Sheep and the Goats'
before: Dead Eye items (no health items allowed)

Start it from John's mission icon.
Stay behind the flock and shout to push the sheep. Don't fire near them.

gold: Herd all the sheep in to the pen in Valentine
Get 25 headshots
Complete with at least 70% accuracy
Complete the mission without taking any health items

Stay behind the flock and use the shout to push them; do not fire near the sheep.

Give to the Poor and Errand Boy can still be finished in Chapters 3 and 4.
Make a manual save now, in a slot you will keep.

before: A Horse Stimulant in your satchel

gold: Return the captive to his family within 1 minute 40 seconds
Get 5 headshots

Complete the mission without taking any health items
goldTips: Spot riders from range and use Dead Eye for clean headshots.
Ride straight back with a Horse Stimulant ready.

steps.title: Make a Chapter 3 start save
how: When Chapter 3 begins, make a manual save in a separate slot and don't overwrite it.
Keep making manual saves before each story mission. If a gold objective fails, reload instead of finishing the mission.

steps.title: Play 'The New South'
how: Start the mission from Dutch's icon at camp.

gold: Knock out Anders Anderson without taking a hit
Catch and return Anders Anderson to jail within 5 minutes 30 seconds
Catch a fish with Dutch and Hosea

steps.title: Do a companion activity at Clemens Point
how: Return to camp during the day and look for an activity you can start now: fishing with Javier or Kieran, or Javier's Valentine home robbery or Charles's hunt if they carried over from Chapter 2.
Sean's and Bill's stagecoach robberies only appear after 'Friends in Very Low Places', so don't wait for them here.
Accept the invitation and play the activity through to the end.
If nobody offers one, do a story mission or sleep in your tent, then check camp again at another time of day.
Don't count on table games (five finger fillet, dominoes) with gang members for this; do an outing instead.

missable.deadline: Before 'Blood Feuds, Ancient and Modern' (Sean's coach robbery: before 'Blessed are the Peacemakers' per one source). Do it before 'Blessed are the Peacemakers' to be safe.

A fact-check against the Red Dead Wiki found the Chapter 3 coach robberies only unlock after 'Friends in Very Low Places', so the route now points at fishing first.

steps.title: Play 'Further Questions of Female Suffrage'
how: Start the mission from Pearson's icon at camp.
Save manually before starting it.
gold: Fend off the Lemoyne Raiders in less than 1 minute
Get 5 headshots
Complete with at least 85% accuracy
Complete the mission without taking any health items

steps.title: Deliver the Chapter 3 camp item requests
how: Spend some daytime (about 08:00-20:00) in camp and talk to gang members until they ask for items.
For Hosea: pick 2 American Ginseng (grows in south Lemoyne).
For Kieran: pick 2 Burdock Root (grows near water).
For Molly: find a Pocket Mirror (at Martha's Swain).
For Tilly: find the Necklace she asks for.
If Pearson asks for his Naval Compass, it is in the boathouse at Braithwaite Manor.
Hand each item over by talking to that person in camp. Keep going until your running total of deliveries reaches 5.
steps.tip: Any 5 deliveries across Chapters 2-4 unlock Errand Boy. If you already have 5 from Chapter 2, these are optional.

missable.deadline: Chapter-3-only requests are gone after 'Blood Feuds, Ancient and Modern'. The trophy itself stays possible until 'Banking, the Old American Art' (Chapter 4).

steps.unverified: Only Game Rant gives the Pocket Mirror location. The Red Dead Wiki (via a search snippet) says item requests also appear in Epilogue Part 2, but most guides treat Errand Boy as lost after Chapter 4.

steps.title: Play 'American Distillation'
how: Start the mission from its map icon (rdr2.org places the start at the Rhodes sheriff's office).
Save manually before starting it.
gold: Win the race back to camp
Complete the mission without taking any damage
Get 10 headshots
Complete with at least 70% accuracy
goldTips: Use cover and Dead Eye so you take zero damage.
Keep horse stamina up for the race.
steps.unverified: Only rdr2.org gives the start location. GamesHedge gives 75% instead of 70% for the accuracy objective.

Save manually before starting it.
gold: Save Uncle when he is overpowered
Get 20 headshots
Complete with at least 80% accuracy
Complete the mission without taking any health items

goldTips: No gold medal for part I (PowerPyx lists only II and III).

missable.deadline: Before 'A Short Walk in a Pretty Town' (safest; another source says before 'Blood Feuds, Ancient and Modern')

gold: Reach Penelope without getting spotted

missable.deadline: Before 'A Short Walk in a Pretty Town' (safest; another source says before 'Blood Feuds, Ancient and Modern')

steps.title: Play 'The Course of True Love - III'

gold: Complete within 4 minutes 15 seconds

how: Start part II from its icon once part I is done.

how: Look for the white stranger icon in Rhodes and start the strand.

steps.title: Do the Stranger strand 'No Good Deed'
how: Look for the white stranger icon in Rhodes and start the strand.
Play every part that becomes available. Anything left over can be finished later.
steps.unverified: The start location (Rhodes) comes from the PowerPyx stranger map, not from the research data.

steps.title: Play 'Magicians for Sport' and loot the rare rifle

Complete the mission without taking any health items
