steps.title: Take a trip into Strawberry
how: Start the mission at the marker on Pronghorn Ranch.
Make sure your Dead Eye meter is full before the confrontation in town.
Afterwards, ride straight back to Pronghorn Ranch; the return is timed.
gold: Kill all 3 enemies in Dead Eye
After the confrontation, return to Pronghorn Ranch within 1 minute 30 seconds

steps.title: Pick up a telegram
how: Speak to the ranch hand at the marker on Pronghorn Ranch.
The mission is short: go straight to each objective to stay inside the time limit.
gold: Complete within 1 minute 30 seconds

steps.title: Take on some bounty work
how: Ride to the mission marker in Valentine.
When you reach Strawberry, skip questioning the townsfolk: go straight to the Welcome Center (hotel) and upstairs to the room by the bathroom.
When the target flees, cut straight across at the rail crossing to catch and hogtie him quickly.
gold: After arriving in Strawberry, locate the bounty within 30 seconds
After mounting your horse, catch and hogtie the bounty within 1 minute 15 seconds
goldTips: Skip questioning townsfolk; go straight to the Strawberry Welcome Center/hotel room upstairs by the bathroom.
Killing the bounty's horse (small honor loss) or cutting straight across at the rail crossing makes the hogtie easy.
steps.tip: Shooting the target's horse makes the hogtie easy but costs a little Honor.
spoiler: The mission giver is Sadie Adler.

steps.title: Watch the Blackwater bank cutscene (no medal)
how: Follow the next mission marker to Blackwater.
'The Landowning Classes' is a cutscene with no gold medal; it leads into the next mission with the bank manager.

steps.title: Inspect a property near Blackwater
how: Start the mission from the Blackwater bank.
Ride straight to each objective; the gold time limit is tight.
gold: Complete within 2 minutes 30 seconds
steps.tip: You take on a bank debt in this mission. You cannot pay it off with your own cash; the Part 2 story clears it, so don't save money for it.

steps.title: Start the Epilogue-only stranger strand
steps.where: A hilltop in West Elizabeth (new white '?' stranger icon)
how: After 'Home of the Gentry?', look for a new white '?' stranger icon on a hilltop in West Elizabeth.
Talk to the writer sitting there to start the strand.
Visit his cabin for each of the five parts; a day or more must pass between parts, so fit them in during Part 2 or after the credits.
Finish all five parts: the strand counts towards Western Stranger and 100%.
steps.unverified: Unlock timing (after 'Home of the Gentry?'), start location and the waits between parts come from web guides, not the research files. Sources disagree on where it starts: south-west of Strawberry (RDR2.org) vs a hill west of Blackwater (PowerPyx). Research confirms it is an Epilogue strand that is not missable.

steps.title: Find an old friend in Saint Denis
how: Start the mission at the marker at Beecher's Hope.
In Saint Denis, head to the fence rather than the bar; speak to the shopkeeper at the door and leave straight away for the next location.
When the enemies appear at the end, tag them all in Dead Eye at once.
gold: After arriving in Saint Denis, find Charles within 1 minute 50 seconds
Kill all of Guido Martelli's men within 10 seconds
goldTips: Go to the fence rather than the bar, speak to the shopkeeper at the door and leave immediately for the next location.
Dead Eye-tag all of Martelli's men at once.

steps.title: Note: the last hunting request is now available
how: The fifth Ms. L. Hobbs hunting request (the Van Horn list) only becomes available after Epilogue Part 1.
You need all five for It's Art and 100%, but there is no deadline.
Leave it for the Cleanup part, where the hunting requests and the squirrel statue are handled together.
steps.unverified: Research wording differs slightly: trophies.json says the last request unlocks after Epilogue Part 1; collectibles.json only says 'in the Epilogue'.

steps.title: Clear out the old shack
how: Start the mission at the marker at Beecher's Hope.
Do NOT skip the opening cutscene: skipping adds loading time that counts against the 18-second limit.
gold: Complete within 18 seconds
goldTips: Do not skip the cutscene (skipping adds load time that counts).

steps.title: Recover a bounty
how: Ride to the mission marker at the Blackwater Saloon.
Don't use any health items during the mission.
Take careful, aimed shots to keep your accuracy above 70%.
gold: Kill all of Langton's men during the horseback escape
After choosing your approach, escape with Shane Finley within 5 minutes
Complete with at least 70% accuracy
Complete the mission without taking any health items

steps.title: Haul lumber for the ranch
how: Equip two sidearms and use only them for the whole mission.
Start the mission at the marker in Blackwater.
Hip-fire the machete rushers; there is no accuracy objective.
When your companion warns about ambushers in the trees, tag their heads carefully in Dead Eye.
Don't use any health items.
gold: Headshot all Skinner Brothers hiding up trees
Find Mr. Wayne within 2 minutes 15 seconds
Complete using only sidearms
Complete the mission without taking any health items
goldTips: Dual-wield; hip-fire the machete rushers (no accuracy requirement).
When Charles mentions the tree ambushers, Dead Eye-tag their heads carefully.

steps.title: Build the house
how: Start the mission at the marker at Beecher's Hope.
Hammer each nail cleanly: sources suggest either rapid presses or holding the button for a split second per nail; use whichever keeps your accuracy above 80%.
Finish the mission: Cowboy Builder unlocks automatically.
gold: Hammer the nails in with 80% accuracy
Complete within 3 minutes 35 seconds
goldTips: Sources differ on technique: fandom suggests rapidly pressing the button; steamgm suggests holding it for a split second per nail.
steps.unverified: Sources disagree on the best nailing technique (rapid presses vs a short hold per nail).

steps.title: Study the ranch dog at Beecher's Hope
steps.where: Beecher's Hope, usually near the front porch
how: Find Rufus, the family dog, near the front porch of the house.
Look at him through your binoculars until he is marked as studied.
steps.tip: Most sources say Rufus is not needed for Zoologist, but studying him takes seconds and removes any doubt.
steps.unverified: Whether Rufus counts for Zoologist is disputed; the usual count of 152 excludes him.

steps.title: Answer a call for help in Rhodes
steps.missionName: A Quick Favor for an Old Friend
how: Equip a shotgun, a long scoped rifle and high-damage weapons before starting.
Start the mission at the marker at Beecher's Hope.
Get your 4 hip-fire kills with the shotgun right at the start of the ambush.
Don't use any health items.
gold: Force Cortez's men to flee from Rhodes within 30 seconds
Get 5 headshots while covering Sadie with a long scoped rifle
Get 4 hip fire kills
Complete the mission without taking any health items
goldTips: Get the hip-fire kills with a shotgun right at the start of the ambush.
Use high-damage weapons to clear Rhodes quickly.

steps.title: Mount a rescue in Tall Trees
how: Make sure you have a bow and arrows equipped.
Start the mission at the marker at Beecher's Hope.
Use Dead Eye with the bow: tagged arrows home in, making the 5 bow headshots easy.
Stay just ahead of your companions and clear enemies so they keep moving.
Near the horses, quickly kill the three enemies that appear behind the group.
Don't use any health items.
gold: Get 5 headshots using the bow
After freeing Uncle, return to Beecher's Hope within 3 minutes 10 seconds
Complete with at least 80% accuracy
Complete the mission without taking any health items
goldTips: Dead Eye-tagged bow shots home in, making the 5 bow headshots easy.
Stay just ahead of Charles and Uncle clearing enemies so they keep moving; kill the three Skinners that spawn behind them near the horses quickly.

steps.title: Watch the next cutscene (no medal)
how: 'The Best of Women' is a cutscene with no gold medal.
Afterwards the next two missions open up; they can be done in either order.
steps.unverified: Placement (right after 'Uncle's Bad Day', before 'Trying Again' and 'A Really Big Bastard') comes from web guides; research only records that it has no medal.

steps.title: Go fishing
how: Start the mission at the marker at Beecher's Hope.
Land a fish before the conversation turns to the dog, then put the rod away immediately to stay inside the time limit.
gold: Catch a fish
Complete within 5 minutes 20 seconds
goldTips: Land a fish before Jack asks about Rufus, then put the rod away immediately.

steps.title: Track a bounty in Tall Trees
how: Start the mission at the marker at Beecher's Hope.
Have a fast-firing weapon ready so you can shoot the charging bear 4 times.
Keep Dead Eye topped up for the two rival bounty hunters.
gold: Shoot the bear 4 times as it charges
Headshot both the rival bounty hunters in Dead Eye
Complete within 7 minutes 15 seconds

steps.title: Spend a day in Blackwater
how: Start the mission at the marker at Beecher's Hope.
Go straight to each objective; the only gold objective is the time limit.
gold: Complete within 7 minutes 30 seconds

steps.title: Save before the final mission
how: Make a manual save now in a separate slot.
Nothing trophy-related is lost by finishing the story: every mission can be replayed afterwards and all collectibles stay available.
Optional insurance: study a Carolina Parakeet in the Lemoyne bayou if you haven't yet (one source claims it can disappear).
Put a repeater with high-velocity ammo and a scoped bolt-action rifle in your weapon loadout.
steps.unverified: Only one source (a Codeberg missables list) treats the Carolina Parakeet as missable; others say it is not needed for Zoologist.

steps.title: Play the final mission
how: Equip a repeater with high-velocity ammo and a scoped bolt-action rifle.
Start the mission at the marker at Beecher's Hope.
For the sniper: advance to the rocks nearest him with your companion, wait for the prompt, then lean out in Dead Eye and tag his head. Leaning out early gets you killed.
Favour body shots to keep accuracy above 85%.
Don't use any health items.
Watch the credits: Endless Summer unlocks for finishing the Epilogue.
gold: Help Sadie catch Cleet within 35 seconds
Headshot the sniper who shoots Charles
Complete with at least 85% accuracy
Complete the mission without taking any health items
goldTips: Bring a repeater with high-velocity ammo and a scoped bolt-action rifle.
For the sniper: advance with Sadie to the rocks nearest him, wait for the prompt, then lean out in Dead Eye and tag his head. Peeking early gets John killed.
85% accuracy - favour body shots.

steps.title: What unlocks after the credits
how: You receive a $20,000 reward.
The game returns you to free roam at Beecher's Hope, with the whole map (including New Austin) open.
Replay any story mission, including optional ones you missed, from Pause > Progress > Story to earn gold medals; Gold Rush needs 70 of the 104.
Replays do NOT count for Lending a Hand.
Carry on with the Cleanup part: gold medals, collectibles, challenges and 100%.
spoiler: You can also pick up Micah's Revolver at the final showdown location on Mount Hagen.
steps.unverified: The Micah's Revolver pick-up comes from a single source (Steam 100% guide).

steps.title: Make a clean post-story save
how: Make a manual save in a new slot before you do anything else. Keep this slot as your 'clean' save for the whole cleanup.
Open Pause > Progress > Total Completion and note which categories are unfinished.
Open Pause > Progress > Story to see which missions still lack a gold medal.
Work through the steps below in order. Tick off any catch-up step whose trophy you already have.
steps.tip: Keep rolling manual saves in two or three slots. Before anything that lowers Honor, save to a separate slot so you can reload it afterwards.

steps.title: If not already unlocked: spend $5000 in shops
steps.where: Any shop: stable, gunsmith, general store, tailor
before: Money from the Epilogue (finishing the Epilogue pays out a large sum)
how: If not already unlocked, make a manual save first.
Spend money at shops: guns and gun upgrades, a new horse and tack, clothes, supplies.
Keep buying until Pony Up unlocks. Spending is cumulative, so earlier purchases already count.
If you want the cash back, reload the save once the trophy has popped.
steps.tip: Do Locked and Loaded (next step) at the same time, so the gunsmith visit does double duty.

steps.title: If not already unlocked: fully upgrade one gun
how: If not already unlocked, make a manual save.
Open the gunsmith's weapon customisation and pick one sidearm or longarm, e.g. the Double-Action Revolver.
Change each component slot on that gun once (grip, barrel length, barrel rifling, sights); you don't need every variant.
Confirm the trophy pops. Reload the save only if you want the money back.

steps.title: If not already unlocked: rob or loot $250
how: If not already unlocked, loot the body of every enemy you kill during encounters, gang hideouts and bounties.
Do some robberies (coaches, shops, homesteads). You need them for 100% anyway.
The total adds up over time. The trophy pops at $250.
steps.tip: Clearing Thieves Landing and Fort Mercer (see the New Austin sweep) gives lots of bodies to loot.

steps.title: If not already unlocked: max bond with a horse
how: If not already unlocked, choose one horse and keep it. Arthur's horses do not carry over to John, so this has to be John's horse.
Ride it every session, pat it (L3 while calming), feed it horse treats and brush it when dirty.
Don't drain its stamina core.
Check the bonding level under Pause > Player > Horse. Bonding level 4 unlocks the trophy and also counts towards 100%.
steps.tip: Bonding builds passively as you ride through the rest of this part, so it usually finishes without extra effort.

steps.title: If not already unlocked: play every table game
how: If not already unlocked, open the Hobby Horse tracker.
Play one game of Five Finger Fillet (e.g. Strawberry).
Play one game of Blackjack (e.g. Rhodes saloon).
Play one game of Dominoes (e.g. the park in Saint Denis).
Play one game of Poker (e.g. a Saint Denis saloon). You don't need to win any of them.
Check Pause > Progress > Total Completion > Table Games.
steps.tip: Stay longer and work on the Gambler challenges while you're there: Blackjack in Rhodes and Van Horn, Five Finger Fillet in Strawberry, Valentine and Van Horn, and Poker in Flatneck Station, Saint Denis and Valentine.

steps.title: If not already unlocked: craft 30 different items
steps.where: Campfire (make camp) and the satchel crafting menu
how: If not already unlocked, make camp and open the crafting menu.
Craft as many different recipes as you can: each ammo type, each arrow type, tonics, cooked and seasoned meats, horse items.
It counts 30 different item types, not 30 crafts. Crafting the same thing again does nothing.
Keep going until the trophy pops.
steps.tip: The same crafts feed Survivalist 4 and 8 (special arrows, tomahawks, volatile dynamite and fire bottles) and the 100% 'craft each recipe type' task.

steps.title: If not already unlocked: rob 4 homestead stashes
steps.where: Homesteads across the map (see the Homesteads tracker)
before: A manual save before each robbery
how: If not already unlocked, open the Homesteads tracker.
Make a manual save before each robbery. Killing the owners or failing can close a homestead for good.
Wear a bandana to reduce the Honor loss.
Chez Porter: the stash is in the barn loft.
Aberdeen Pig Farm: greet the owners, then take the stash from the back room.
Lonnie's Shack: threaten a survivor to learn where the stash is.
Catfish Jackson's: threaten the son. The stash is in the chimney or an outside crate.
Watson's Cabin: the shotgun in the cellar counts as the stash.
Loot everything else in the homestead as well. The counter can fail to register if you only take the stash.
Stop at 4 stashes.
steps.tip: One home robbery also ticks the 100% robbery task. If a homestead you already visited as Arthur is empty or its owners are gone, use a different one.
steps.unverified: The research doesn't confirm which homesteads can still be robbed after the story if Arthur disturbed them. Willard's Rest (Chapter 6+) and the Van Horn mansion are left out here because the missables research lists some Arthur-era events there as lost after Chapter 6.

steps.title: If not already unlocked: finish A Bright Bouncing Boy
steps.where: Stranger icon for Marko Dragic (see the Strangers tracker)
how: If not already unlocked, go to Marko Dragic's stranger icon and continue the strand.
Do part II at night. Sleep until night if you need to.
Wait about 2 in-game days, then return for the final part.
Artificial Intelligence unlocks at the end of the strand.
steps.tip: This is also one of the 22 strands that count for Western Stranger.

steps.title: Sweep New Austin: bones, animals, herbs, hideouts
steps.where: New Austin (Cholla Springs, Gaptooth Ridge, Rio Bravo) and the West Elizabeth border
before: Plenty of ammo and a bonded horse
how: Open the Dinosaur Bones tracker and collect the 8 New Austin bones. Mail all 30 locations at a post office when you have them.

Study with binoculars, then kill and skin, the New Austin-only animals: Nine-Banded Armadillo, Californian Condor, Banded Gila Monster, Desert Iguana, Collared Peccary, Sonoran and Baja California Pronghorn (buck and doe), California Quail, Desert Bighorn Ram and Sheep, Black-tailed Rattlesnake, Sonoran Desert Toad and Rio Grande Wild Turkey.
Come back at night for the Californian Horned Owl.
Pick every herb you pass. Herbalist 9 (one of each of the 43 herb species) needs the New Austin plants.
Clear the gang hideouts at Thieves Landing and Fort Mercer if you haven't. Both are needed for the 6 hideouts in 100%.
Ride from Van Horn to Blackwater in under 17 minutes without touching water for Horseman 9, if it's still open.
Fish for the Legendary Redfin Pickerel and Legendary Largemouth Bass while you're here (see the legendary fish step).
steps.tip: Loot every hideout body. It helps Take from the Rich and your cash for Pony Up.

steps.title: If not already unlocked: finish one collectible strand
steps.where: Post office, then the strand's quest giver
how: If not already unlocked, pick the strand you are closest to finishing. Rock Carvings (Geology for Beginners, 10 carvings) is the quickest.
Rock Carvings: open the Rock Carvings tracker, find all 10, mail the locations at a post office, wait about 2 days, then visit Francis Sinclair's hut north-west of Strawberry.
Dinosaur Bones: with all 30 found (New Austin sweep), mail them, wait about 1 day, then meet Deborah MacGuiness at Firwood Rise to finish A Test of Faith.
Exotics: finish every Duchesses and other Animals list for Algernon Wasp in north Saint Denis (see the exotics step).
Cigarette Cards: only if you want all 144. Mail all 12 sets to finish Smoking and other Hobbies.
Collector's Item unlocks when the final visit of the strand is done.
steps.tip: After the Geology for Beginners finale, go back into the cabin at once and take the Old Brass Compass. The cabin locks afterwards. Rock carvings, bones and exotics are all needed for 100% anyway, so none of this work is wasted.

steps.title: Visit all 9 graves
steps.where: Across the map (see the Graves tracker)
how: Open the Graves tracker. The graves only appear after the story.
Two graves side by side in Bluewater Marsh, north of Saint Denis and east of Lagras (tap reveal for names).
A hill above Flat Iron Lake, north-west of Rhodes.
A field east of Braithwaite Manor, towards Bolger Glade.
A cliff above the railway near Emerald Station.
East of Bacchus Station.
The west side of Donner Falls.
Colter.
Near Spider Gorge / Glacier, north of Colter.
At each one, walk up and use the interact prompt so it registers. Any order works.
spoiler: Bluewater Marsh: Hosea and Lenny. Flat Iron Lake: Sean. Near Braithwaite Manor: Kieran. Near Emerald Station: Susan. East of Bacchus Station: Arthur. Donner Falls: Eagle Flies. Colter: Davey. Near Spider Gorge: Jenny.
steps.unverified: Sources disagree on some spots. HoldToReset and Pixeltwelve (via search summaries) put Susan's grave on a hill south-west of Elysian Pool, and Kieran's between Shady Belle and Bolger Glade. If a grave isn't where this list says, check those alternatives or use the tracker pin.

steps.title: Finish the hunting requests and the statue
steps.where: Train stations (request posters), post office, Ms. Hobbs east of Strawberry, Beecher's Hope
before: All 5 hunting requests (A Better World, A New Friend). The 5th, at Van Horn, only appears in the Epilogue.
how: Take any hunting request posters you still need from the train stations.
Hunt each requested animal for a perfect carcass and mail it from a post office.
Once all 5 are done, visit Ms. Hobbs east of Strawberry and collect the squirrel statue.
Put the statue on the living-room fireplace at Beecher's Hope, then sleep.

When it goes missing, find it and put it back on the fireplace each time. The hiding places, in order: the chest in the main bedroom, the main bedroom chimney, the chest in the loft above the kitchen, the wheelbarrow by the barn, the chest on the barn's upper floor, and finally Mount Shann, north of Strawberry.
Put it back one last time. It's Art unlocks.
steps.tip: Sleep once after each time you put the statue back, so it moves to the next hiding place.

steps.title: Catch the 13 legendary fish
steps.where: Lagras bait shop, then the Legendary Fish tracker spots; post office
before: Special Lake, River and Swamp Lures ($20 each, Lagras bait shop)
A Fisher of Fish started with Jeremy Gill, north shore of Flat Iron Lake
how: Open the Legendary Fish tracker.
Buy all three special lures in Lagras. Any special lure works on every legendary fish; the right one just makes it bite faster. Don't use bait.
If nothing bites for about a minute, press R2/L2 once to attract fish.
Catch a heavy one early, such as the Lake Sturgeon (railway bridge south-west of Saint Denis) or the Longnose Gar (Bayou Nwa). Anything over 16 lb unlocks It was THIS Big!
Mail each legendary fish to Jeremy Gill from a post office. Carry big ones on your horse; small ones fit in the satchel.
Leave the Rock Bass, Redfin Pickerel and Largemouth Bass for now if you haven't caught them; do them as John in the New Austin sweep.
Once all 13 are mailed, finish part II when Jeremy Gill's invitation arrives.
steps.tip: The same trips cover Survivalist 9 (a fish of 19 lb or more) and Survivalist 10 (one of each fish type). Legendary fish can't be sold or cooked, so if you lose one, catch it again. The Channel Catfish and Northern Pike are extras, not needed.
steps.unverified: Sources disagree on the total: 13 are needed for A Fisher of Fish, but some guides count 14 or 15 (adding the Channel Catfish and Northern Pike). Only the 13 are required.

steps.title: Finish exotics, dreamcatchers and treasure hunts
steps.where: Lemoyne swamps and Saint Denis (exotics); across the map (dreamcatchers, treasure)
how: If Duchesses and other Animals is unfinished, open the Exotics tracker. Hand each list to Algernon Wasp at the greenhouse in north Saint Denis. The next list opens only after you hand in the previous one.
Farm egrets, herons and spoonbills around noon in western Bayou Nwa and Bluewater Marsh. To respawn birds, ride away (e.g. to Rhodes), sleep, then come back.
Open the Dreamcatchers tracker and find all 20. Then go through the waterfall at Elysian Pool for the Ancient Arrowhead.

Open the Treasure Hunts tracker. For all 10 Explorer challenges, finish three chains: Jack Hall Gang, Poisonous Trail and High Stakes (9 finds plus finding a map). One chain is enough for the 100% treasure task.
steps.tip: Plants glow blue in Eagle Eye. Picking exotics orchids also helps Herbalist 9.

steps.title: Finish 10 stranger strands (aim for 12)
steps.where: White '?' stranger icons (see the Strangers tracker)
how: Open the Strangers tracker and Pause > Progress > Total Completion > Strangers to see which strands are finished.

Only these 22 strands count: The Noblest of Men, and a Woman; The Smell of the Grease Paint; Arcadia for Amateurs; American Dreams; A Fine Night For It; Geology for Beginners; A Test of Faith; Smoking and other Hobbies; He's British, of Course; A Fisher of Fish; The Iniquities of History; No Good Deed; Oh, Brother; A Bright Bouncing Boy; The Mercies of Knowledge; The Artist's Way; The Ties That Bind Us; Duchesses and other Animals; Idealism and Pragmatism for Beginners; The Wisdom of the Elders; The Veteran; The American Inferno, Burnt Out.
These do NOT count: All That Glitters, Fundraiser, Help a Brother Out, The Widow of Willard's Rest.
Don't rely on A Better World, A New Friend, Brothers and Sisters, One and All, Of Men and Angels or To the Ends of the Earth. It isn't confirmed whether they count.
Finish every part of each strand. A half-done strand counts for nothing.
The collectible strands from earlier steps (Geology, Test of Faith, Fisher of Fish, Duchesses) already count, so you may be close.
Keep going past 10 until the trophy pops.
steps.tip: 10 strands are also needed for 100%. The trophy can lag behind the 10/10 count, so finishing 12 gives you a safety margin.
steps.unverified: Collectibles research says all 22 strands can be finished after the story. The missables research says some Arthur-only parts (e.g. The Mercies of Knowledge, Arcadia for Amateurs III) are lost after Chapter 6. If a strand has no icon left, choose another. PowerPyx reports some players needed 12+ strands.

steps.title: Study every animal and skin every species
steps.where: The whole main map (Guarma not needed)
how: Open the Zoologist and Skin Deep trackers, and Pause > Progress > Compendium > Animals.
Always study first: get close, aim with binoculars and press R1 when Study appears. Tracking alone doesn't count. Then kill and skin.
Zoologist needs 152 species. Study every variant separately, including all 12 dogs (except Rufus), the cat, chickens and roosters, pigs, bulls, oxen, cow, goat, sheep, mule and donkey.

Skin Deep needs every wild species that gives a pelt, hide or skin (about 71). This includes big birds: ducks, geese, herons, egrets, loons, pheasants, turkeys, the prairie chicken and the roseate spoonbill.

Night-only: find the Little Brown Bat, Silver Fox and owls at night. Bear Claw near Manzanita Post is good for all three common owls. The Great Horned Owl often shows up around Radley's House near Rhodes.
Get the Cuban Land Crab and Green Iguana at Flat Iron Lake. Skin the iguana on the largest island.
Farm snakes in the swamp around Shady Belle. Skin a Northern Water Snake too, to be safe.
Study Rufus at Beecher's Hope and a Carolina Parakeet in Bayou Nwa as insurance. It costs nothing.
To cycle spawns, sleep at a camp, or save, quit to the menu and continue.
steps.tip: A poison throwing knife makes an aggressive animal wander off so you can study it. After skinning, check the species shows Skinned in the compendium; one player's moose didn't register until he skinned another.
steps.unverified: The Zoologist count is 152 in most sources but 165 in one. Skin Deep is quoted as 71, but the only full list names 70 (Northern Water Snake is the likely 71st). Whether Rufus and the Carolina Parakeet are required is disputed. If Skin Deep doesn't pop, also skin one of each livestock type (bull, ox, cow, pig, sheep, goat).

steps.title: Survive 18 bear attacks
steps.where: Between Wallace Station and Watson's Cabin, north of Little Creek River
before: A strong repeater or shotgun (e.g. fully upgraded Carbine Repeater) with Express ammo
how: Ride to the area between Wallace Station and Watson's Cabin. Other spots are east of the legendary bear area and around Barrow Lagoon.
Look for grizzly bears, mostly in the morning and at midday.
Let the bear knock you down. Press Circle to break free, then shoot it from the ground during the struggle until it dies.
Only kills made during the struggle count. Shooting it any other way doesn't.
To respawn bears, leave the area (e.g. take the train to Saint Denis and back), make camp and sleep until morning, or reload a save.
Repeat until you have 18. Check progress on the Rockstar Social Club.
steps.tip: Expect 5-10 hours because spawns are random. Skin the bears: 3 of them clear Master Hunter 5.
steps.unverified: One source summary says only grizzlies count and black bears don't; nothing else confirms or denies it. Farm grizzlies to be safe.

steps.title: Replay missions for 70 gold medals
how: Open the Gold Medals tracker and count your golds. You need 70 of the 104 medal missions.
Open Pause > Progress > Story, pick a completed mission without a gold, and choose Replay.
Read the gold objectives in the tracker before you start. All of them must be met in one run.
Restart from the checkpoint the moment an objective fails.
Skip cutscenes on timed missions, because the timer includes them. Exception: don't skip the cutscene in Home Improvement for Beginners.
Choose the easiest missions first. You have 34 spare, so skip known hard ones: The Course of True Love II, Angelo Bronte, a Man of Honor, Visiting Hours and The Course of True Love V.
Don't abandon a replay you have made challenge progress in. Abandoning it discards that progress.
steps.tip: The Special Edition mission High and Low Finance is not part of the 104 and may not count. Last-resort fallback for a missed Lending a Hand: PowerPyx reported that replaying Home Improvement for Beginners after the story once unlocked it anyway. This may be patched, so don't count on it.
steps.unverified: Sources disagree on the replay loadout. Some (PowerPyx, the missables research) say replays give a fixed, basic loadout without your tonics. The Red Dead Wiki says that since patch 1.15 replays keep your stats, give 3 of each tonic and let you use your chosen horse. Plan for the basic loadout.

steps.title: Complete all 90 challenges
how: Open the Challenges tracker. There are 9 categories of 10: Bandit, Explorer, Gambler, Herbalist, Horseman, Master Hunter, Sharpshooter, Survivalist, Weapons Expert.
Each category unlocks in order. Progress made before a challenge is active doesn't count, so re-do herbs for Herbalist 6 and 9.
Herbalist 9: pick all 43 herb species, including the New Austin ones.
Horseman 9: ride from Van Horn to Blackwater in under 17 minutes without touching water.
Horseman 10: break every wild horse breed (9 in most sources). Watch the in-game checklist for the last one.
Master Hunter 9: chase an opossum until it plays dead, then pick it up. This makes the Giaguaro Panther spawn for Master Hunter 10.
Weapons Expert 8: fit a long barrel to a revolver or pistol, then kill 15 enemies with it.
Weapons Expert 10: kill a grizzly with throwing knives only, without taking damage.
Bandit challenges involve crimes. Make a manual save first and wear a mask to reduce the Honor loss.
steps.tip: If the opossum won't count when you pick it up, shooting it is the fallback. Killing the Giaguaro also counts as one of the 5 legendary animals for 100%.
steps.unverified: Horseman 10 is 9 breeds in most sources but 10 in the Steam guide. The Weapons Expert 8 wording is 'long-barrelled sidearm' in most sources, but PowerPyx says shotgun.

steps.title: Close out 100% completion
how: Open the Completion tracker and Pause > Progress > Total Completion. Go through each category until everything is ticked.
Missions: all story missions, 10 stranger strands, 5 bounties, 25 random encounters, 1 gang ambush, 6 gang hideouts (Thieves Landing and Fort Mercer post-story).

Collectibles: 1 point of interest, 9 graves, 1 full cigarette card set (12 cards), all 30 dinosaur bones, 13 legendary fish, all exotics, 10 rock carvings, all 5 hunting requests, 1 treasure hunt chain, 20 dreamcatchers.
Compendium: 50 animals, 10 equipment, 10 fish, 6 gangs, 10 horse breeds, 20 plants, 48 weapons.
Player: Health, Stamina and Dead Eye cores at max level (10), horse bonding level 4, all 90 challenges.

Miscellaneous: 5 shacks, 5 legendary animals, each table game once, 5 ranters/ravers, a bath, a show, a Théâtre Râleur show, one of each of the 6 recipe types crafted, and one coach, home, shop and train robbery.
Best in the West unlocks at 100%.
steps.tip: Cigarette cards: the fastest way to finish a set is to buy Premium Cigarettes at a general store, drop the pack and buy again. Never sell a card you still need to mail. Only 48 of the weapons are needed, which covers the missable ones. Do the robberies from a backup save if you care about Honor.
steps.unverified: One PowerPyx page implies all 144 cigarette cards are needed. Its own checklist and the wiki say one set of 12 is enough.

steps.title: Hold a $250 bounty in all states for 3 days
steps.where: Lemoyne, New Hanover, West Elizabeth, Ambarino, New Austin, then a remote spot
before: All other cleanup you want to keep, saved in your clean slot
A new manual save in a separate backup slot (this tanks Honor)
how: Make a manual save in a separate slot. Consider switching off autosave so the crime spree can't overwrite your clean save.
Raise your bounty to $250 or more in Lemoyne, New Hanover, West Elizabeth and Ambarino.
Check New Austin's bounty on the map. If it isn't already $250+, build one there too.
Ambarino is the hardest. Rob a train after it crosses into Ambarino, or kill someone in the wilds and carry the body until a witness reports you.
Dying while you build bounties doesn't matter. Only holding all 5 at once counts.
With all 5 at $250+, go somewhere remote, make camp and sleep through 3 in-game days.
Bountiful unlocks. Carry straight on to Extreme Personality from this same save.
steps.tip: This also clears Bandit 5 ($250 bounty in one state), but that progress is lost if you later reload the backup save.
steps.unverified: PowerPyx says New Austin carries a built-in bounty during the story; another source says you never need to make one there. Check the map rather than assuming.

steps.title: If not already unlocked: hit max or min Honor
before: The backup save from the Bountiful step (or a new manual save)
how: If not already unlocked, keep playing from the backup save you made for Bountiful.
Low route (fastest): commit crimes, kill and loot civilians until the Honor bar reaches the far left.
High route instead: help strangers, bring bounties in alive, catch and release fish and donate, until the bar reaches the far right.
Check the Honor bar (d-pad down) as you go. The trophy pops at either end.
Once it has popped, reload your clean save to get your normal Honor and bounties back. Anything else you did after the backup save is undone.
steps.tip: Doing the low route straight after Bountiful uses the same crime spree for both trophies. The high route needs no reload, but it takes much longer.

steps.title: Finish the Red Dead Online intro
steps.where: Title screen > Red Dead Online (or Story Mode: Pause > Online)
how: Choose Red Dead Online from the title screen, or from Story Mode open Pause > Online.
Create your character in the opening prison sequence and take the mugshot.
Follow the opening missions: go to the camp, use the wardrobe and set up your camp with Cripps.
Collect the first job at the post office, clear the gang hideout and use the treasure map from the last enemy to find the chest (use Eagle Eye to spot it).
Do Clay Davies' horse-theft mission and deliver the horse to the Valentine stables.
Return to your camp and talk to Cripps; the trophy pops after the cutscene and Free Roam opens up.
steps.tip: The intro takes about 1-2 hours and can't be skipped. Almost every other online trophy needs it done first.
steps.unverified: No source confirms whether the standalone Red Dead Online product uses the same trophy list. Play Online through the full RDR2 game to be safe.

steps.title: Pick 25 plants
how: Pick any 25 plants: herbs, berries, mushrooms and flowers all count.
Use Eagle Eye (click L3 + R3) to highlight plants you can pick.
Check progress under Pause > Progress > Awards > Survivalist.
steps.tip: Takes under 10 minutes. Pick plants on the way to your first hunt.

steps.title: Sell 20 items to a Butcher
steps.where: Any Butcher: Valentine, Strawberry, Blackwater, Rhodes, Saint Denis or Tumbleweed
how: Hunt and skin animals; pelts, meat, feathers, fat and carcasses all count.
Keep a few pieces of meat for the next step (Master Craftsman).
Sell 20 items in total at any Butcher.
Check progress under Pause > Progress > Awards > Trade.
steps.tip: Skinning large animals gives several sellable items at once. One or two hunting trips is enough.

steps.title: Craft 20 non-ammo items at a campfire
steps.where: Your camp's fire or any campfire you set up
how: Go to a campfire and open crafting.
Cook meat, plain or with herbs.
Keep cooking until you have crafted 20 non-ammo items.
Check progress under Pause > Progress > Awards > Survivalist.
steps.tip: Only a few minutes of work. Ammo does not count here; that is Non-Regulation.
steps.unverified: PowerPyx says cooking and eating a piece counts as 2 while stowing counts as 1. Only one source reports this, so watch the award counter rather than relying on it.

steps.title: Play 5 Free Roam Events
how: Play in a public Free Roam session.
When a Free Roam Event invitation appears (purple text on the left of the screen), press the button shown on screen straight away to join.
Stay until the event ends; you don't need to win or place well.
Repeat until you have finished 5 events.
steps.tip: Accept every event invitation you see while doing the other steps. Don't quit mid-event, or it won't count. Monthly bonuses sometimes boost Free Roam Event rewards, which also helps your rank.
steps.unverified: Older guides say events start roughly every 45 minutes; the timing may have changed since.

steps.title: Complete 10 Free Roam missions
steps.where: Orange circle mission-giver icons in and near towns
how: Open the map and look for the small orange circle mission-giver icons.
Walk up to the character, accept their Free Roam mission and complete it.
Take missions from several different givers.
Repeat until you have done 10.
Check progress under Pause > Progress > Awards > Free Roam.
steps.tip: All of these can be done solo. If a giver has no icon, try another town.
steps.unverified: Sources disagree on whether any 10 missions count or they must come from different givers. Spreading them across givers covers both readings.

steps.title: Buy 5 camp improvements with dollars
how: Do this before you ever buy a camp item with gold bars.
Go to your camp, talk to Cripps and open the camp upgrades menu.
Buy 5 different camp flags with dollars ($50 each), all in one visit without leaving the menu.
If the trophy doesn't pop, buy a 6th different improvement with dollars.
steps.tip: Never pay for camp improvements with gold bars until this trophy pops. Some upgrades are rank-locked, but the flags are available early.
steps.unverified: This trophy is reported as buggy. Gold-bar purchases may not count and may break it for that character. Some players needed a 6th purchase. Reports suggest that as a last resort you can reset the character and try again. Flag prices come from older guides.

steps.title: Own 5 horses at the same time
before: About $1,700 (check the stable menu for current prices)
how: Save up enough money first, then visit any stable. Your first stall is free.
Buy the 4 extra stalls (about $100, $150, $500 and $750).
Fill all 5 stalls: buy the cheapest horse (Kentucky Saddler, about $50) or use horses you break or claim.
The trophy pops when you own 5 horses at once.
steps.tip: Buy the stalls and horses in one go. Every horse you own adds to stable upkeep.
steps.unverified: Stall and horse prices come from 2018-2019 guides and may have changed since. No 2025-2026 source confirms them. Budget about $1,700 and check the stable menu.

steps.title: Craft 25 pieces of ammunition
before: Rank 28 for the Split Point pamphlet (or Rank 22 for Small Game Arrows)
At least 25 normal rounds of a matching calibre
how: If you aren't Rank 22 yet, skip this step for now and come back when you reach it.
At Rank 28, buy the Split Point ammo pamphlet from a Fence. It only needs regular bullets.
Or, at Rank 22, buy the Small Game Arrow pamphlet instead. It needs arrows, shotgun shells and flight feathers.
Go to a campfire, open crafting and choose the Ammo tab.
Craft the same ammo type again and again until you have made 25 pieces.
Check progress under Pause > Progress > Awards > Survivalist.
steps.tip: You pass Rank 28 on the way to Rank 50 anyway, so there's no rush.
steps.unverified: The Rank 22 and 28 pamphlet requirements come from 2018-2019 guides and may have changed. Check the Fence catalogue for the ranks it shows.

steps.title: Play a Series to the end
steps.where: Pause > Online > Series playlists (or Player Menu > Quick Join)
how: Open Pause > Online and pick any Series: Showdown Series, Race Series or the weekly Featured Series.
Or press d-pad left for the Player Menu and use Quick Join.
Play the whole match; the trophy pops after the results screen, not when you join.
steps.tip: Any series type counts, races included. Don't quit early. Every series you play is also a chance at MVP for The Real Deal.
steps.unverified: Playlists rotate in 2026, so the named series may not always be available. Any series counts.

steps.title: Earn 5 gold award buckles
how: Open Pause > Progress > Awards to see each award's bronze, silver and gold tiers.
Reach the gold tier on any 5 awards.
Quick options: kill a flying bird with an arrow (Hunting) and the timed rides between towns (Travel).
More quick options: sell to 3 different shop types or spend $1,000 in shops (Trade), and max your horse bond (Horse).
steps.tip: Skip the Posse category; those awards are long grinds. This often pops naturally during the Rank 50 grind.

steps.title: Reach Rank 10
how: Keep playing the Red Dead Online story missions, Free Roam missions, series and Daily Challenges.
Check your rank under Pause > Progress > Rank Unlocks.
The trophy pops at Rank 10, after about 8,000-10,000 XP in total.
steps.tip: This usually comes within the first few hours, often while doing the steps above.

steps.title: Form a Persistent Posse
before: $200 set-up fee (may be free during a Rockstar event)
how: Press d-pad left to open the Player Menu, then go to Posse > Form Posse.
Set the posse type to Persistent (not Temporary), name it and confirm.
The trophy pops right away, even if you are the only member.
Keep the posse for the next step (Strength in Numbers).
steps.tip: The fee isn't refunded if you disband the posse. Rockstar sometimes waives it; one waiver ran from 30 June to 3 August 2026.
steps.unverified: The $200 fee comes from older guides. No source confirms that the trophy pops when the fee is waived, though creating the posse should be the trigger.

steps.title: Do a Free Roam mission in a 2-player posse
steps.where: Any orange Free Roam mission giver
before: One other real player (friend or someone in your session)
how: Invite a friend or a player in your session to your posse (a free Temporary posse also works).
Or open Pause > Online > Posse Up to join a random posse.
With at least 2 members in the posse, start any Free Roam mission (orange icon).
Complete the mission; the trophy pops at the end.
steps.tip: This can't be done alone. Pair it with the All's Fair boost: do this mission together first, then your friend leaves the posse for the next step.

steps.title: Sabotage a rival player's Free Roam mission
steps.where: Public Free Roam session with a friend or other players
before: A friend in the same session but NOT in your posse (recommended)
how: Have your friend join your session but stay out of your posse.
Your friend accepts a Free Roam mission from a giver who stands outdoors.
When the mission starts, go to their objective and stop them, for example by killing the target or the carriage horses.
The trophy pops when their mission fails.
Without a friend, watch for the red notification that a nearby player has started a mission you can counter, then go and stop them.
steps.tip: With a friend this takes a few minutes. Using an outdoor giver matters: indoor givers reportedly moved players to another session. You don't need to be in a posse yourself.

steps.title: Earn MVP 3 times in 4+ player series
before: A series lobby with at least 4 players
how: Join series with at least 4 players in the lobby. The 3 MVPs don't need to be in a row.
Solo, option A: play territory modes such as Hostile Territory or Takeover. Capture a point near your spawn and hold it as long as you can.
Solo, option B: play Race Series, where the winner almost always gets MVP. In Open Races, learn a checkpoint route (Tumbleweed and Saint Denis/Rhodes are recommended).
In standard races, hang back to avoid the opening pile-up, then catch up.
Solo, option C: play Hardcore series (free aim, no ability cards or tonics), which evens out the odds against veterans.
Boosting: get a group of 4 friends and queue a quiet series so only your group fills the lobby.
When boosting, take turns being MVP until everyone has 3.
steps.tip: MVP comes from the game's overall performance score, not just kills or winning, so the MVP can be on the losing team. In 2025 one player got MVP in about 15 games by sprinting to capture points. Another got 2 from races and 1 from Hostile Territory by camping an objective. Choose popular or Featured Series for solo attempts.
steps.unverified: Lobby sizes in 2025-2026 depend on the playlist; some (such as Elimination) are thin, and races are full of veterans. Playlists rotate, so the named modes may not always be available. The old TrueTrophies 'Call to Arms' posse boost reportedly stopped working in 2023; don't rely on it. Boosting groups were still forming in 2026.

steps.title: Reach Rank 50
how: Finish the Red Dead Online story missions for good XP and cash.
Do all 7 Daily Challenges every real-life day for XP and streak bonuses.
Keep doing Free Roam missions, Free Roam Events and series.
For bonus XP, get kills from horseback, headshots, Dead Eye kills and special-ammo kills.
Take up the Collector role: buy the Collector's Bag from Madame Nazar with gold bars (watch for discounts).
Collect and sell complete collectible sets; items and sets give XP, and collectibles reset daily.
Check Rockstar's current monthly bonuses and play whatever is boosted.
Track progress under Pause > Progress > Rank Unlocks.
steps.tip: Rank 50 takes roughly 175,000 XP. Gold award buckles give XP, and Buckle Up, Gun For Hire and Eventful come naturally along the way. A community collector map (for example jeanropke's RDR2 Collectors Map) makes daily collector routes quick.
steps.unverified: Sources disagree on the total XP: about 175,000 (PowerPyx and the Red Dead Wiki table) versus over 200,000 (PSNProfiles). Trust the in-game Rank Unlocks screen. Time estimates range from about 40 hours to about 100 hours. Monthly bonuses rotate; the June-August 2026 triple XP on bounties and Free Roam Events has ended.

steps.title: Final check: unlock the platinum
how: Open the Trophies screen in this app.
Go through the list and confirm every trophy other than Legend of the West is marked done: 34 Story Mode and 17 Online.
Compare with the trophy list on your console and look for any trophy that hasn't popped.
For any trophy still missing, go back to its step in the route or its tracker and finish it.
Legend of the West pops automatically once the last trophy unlocks.
steps.tip: The 4 missable story trophies (Lending a Hand, Friends With Benefits, Give to the Poor, Errand Boy) need a new Story Mode save if you missed them. Check those first.

trophies.name: Legend of the West
trophies.description: Unlock all other trophies.
howTo: Earn all 34 other single-player trophies and all 17 Red Dead Online trophies.
Protect the 4 missable story trophies (Lending a Hand, Friends With Benefits, Give to the Poor, Errand Boy) in your first playthrough - they force a new game if missed.
tips: Estimated 240-300 hours total (about 200 story, 40-100 online); difficulty about 6/10 per PowerPyx/DamnModz.

trophies.name: Best in the West
trophies.description: Attain 100% completion.
howTo: Finish all story missions (optional ones can be skipped for 100%).
Complete 10 Stranger strands, 5 bounties, 25 random encounters, 1 gang ambush and all 6 gang hideouts.

Collectibles: 1 point of interest, all 9 graves, 1 full cigarette card set (12), 30 dinosaur bones, 13 legendary fish, all exotics requests, 10 rock carvings, all hunting requests, 1 treasure map chain, 20 dreamcatchers.
Compendium: 50 animals, 10 equipment, 10 fish, 6 gangs, 10 horse breeds, 20 plants, 48 weapons.
Raise the Health, Stamina and Dead Eye attributes to level 10, reach bonding level 4 with a horse and complete all 90 challenges (9 categories x 10).

Misc: 5 shacks, 5 legendary animals, play each table game once, 5 ranters/ravers, a bath, a show, a Théâtre Râleur show, craft one of each of 6 recipe types, and one coach, home, shop and train robbery.
tips: Use Progress > Total Completion to see what is outstanding instead of guessing.
Weapons: only 48 of 59 are needed, which covers the few missable ones.

trophies.name: Endless Summer
trophies.description: Complete the Epilogue.
howTo: Finish the Epilogue. The game continues in free roam afterwards for cleanup.

trophies.name: Collector's Item
trophies.description: Complete one of the Collectable strands.
howTo: Choose one: all 10 Rock Carvings (quickest), all 30 Dinosaur Bones, all 144 Cigarette Cards, or all Exotics requests.
Turn in / finish the associated stranger strand if one applies.
tips: 100% only needs 1 cigarette card set, but Rock Carvings, Dinosaur Bones and Exotics are all needed for 100% anyway.
Only strands tied to a Stranger count; dreamcatchers are not a strand for this trophy (PowerPyx).
You will need rock carvings, bones and exotics anyway for Best in the West.

trophies.name: Gold Rush
trophies.description: Earn 70 Gold Medals in Story missions.
howTo: During the story, try to meet each mission's optional gold objectives (shown after the mission and in the mission log).
Replay missed missions via Pause > Progress > Story, select a completed mission, and replay it.
Pick the 70 easiest; there are 34 spare medals, so skip any mission that repeatedly wastes time.
tips: Replays let you carry better gear/stats, making later attempts easier.
Restart a checkpoint as soon as you fail an objective.

trophies.name: Lending a Hand
trophies.description: Complete all optional Honor story missions.
trophies.missableDeadline: Each chapter's honor missions are lost when that chapter ends (Chapter 2: before 'The Sheep and the Goats' to be safe; Chapter 3: before 'Blood Feuds, Ancient and Modern'; Chapter 4: before 'Banking, the Old American Art'). Chapter 6: Of Men and Angels and Do Not Seek Absolution before 'The Fine Art of Conversation'; Mrs. Sadie Adler, Widow before 'My Last Boy'. Replaying after the story does not count.
howTo: Chapter 2: do Money Lending and Other Sins I-III (Strauss debts), Good, Honest, Snake Oil (Valentine sheriff's office area), We Loved Once and True I-III (letter in Arthur's tent).
Chapter 3: do The Course of True Love I-III (Beau Gray, Rhodes) and Money Lending and Other Sins IV.
Chapter 4: do Help a Brother Out and Brothers and Sisters, One and All (Brother Dorkins, Saint Denis), Fatherhood and Other Dreams I-II, Money Lending and Other Sins V.

Chapter 6: do Do Not Seek Absolution I-II (Edith Downes, Annesburg - needs high Honor), Of Men and Angels I-II, The Course of True Love IV-V, Archeology for Beginners, Honor, Amongst Thieves, Money Lending and Other Sins VI-VII, Mrs. Sadie Adler, Widow I-II.
In Archeology for Beginners, agree to help Captain Monroe - this spawns Honor, Amongst Thieves.
Before ending each chapter check the Progress > Story log for yellow honor-mission icons you haven't done, and keep a chapter-start manual save.
tips: Do each honor mission as soon as its icon appears; several despawn as the story advances.
Play honorably (greet people, help strangers, don't kill civilians) through Chapters 2-6 so Chapter 6 honor gating is never an issue.

trophies.name: Redemption
trophies.description: Complete 'Red Dead Redemption'.
howTo: Before starting the final Chapter 6 mission, make sure every Chapter 6 optional honor mission is complete (Lending a Hand) and keep a manual save.
Complete 'Red Dead Redemption'.

trophies.name: Artificial Intelligence
trophies.description: Discover the fate of Marko Dragic.
howTo: Start 'A Bright Bouncing Boy' with Marko Dragic (Chapter 4+).
Do part II at night (sleep if needed).
Wait about 2 in-game days, then return for the final part to find out what happened to Dragic.
tips: Counts toward Western Stranger as well.

trophies.name: Back in the Mud
trophies.description: Complete Chapter 1.
howTo: Play through the story until Chapter 1 ends.

trophies.name: Bountiful
trophies.description: Survive 3 days holding a bounty of $250 in all states.
howTo: Make a manual backup save (and consider turning off autosave).
Raise bounties to $250+ in Lemoyne, New Hanover, West Elizabeth, Ambarino and New Austin (New Austin already carries a story-related bounty per PowerPyx).
Ambarino is hardest: rob a train after it crosses into Ambarino, or kill a civilian in the wilds and carry the body until a witness reports you.
Once all states have $250+, go somewhere remote, make camp and sleep through 3 days (or sleep in a rented room repeatedly).
tips: Dying while building bounties doesn't matter; only the 3 days holding all 5 counts.
Easier in the Epilogue with better weapons.

trophies.name: Breaking and Entering
trophies.description: Recover the stash from 4 homesteads.
howTo: Loot 4 of these 7: Chez Porter (barn loft stash), Aberdeen Pig Farm (back room after greeting the owners), Lonnie's Shack (threaten a survivor for the stash location), Van Horn Mansion (money on downstairs table), Catfish Jackson's (threaten the son; chimney or outside crate), Watson's Cabin (cellar - the shotgun counts as the stash), Willard's Rest (Chapter 6+, lockbox after the dinner scene).
Make a manual save before each robbery - killing owners or failing can close off a homestead.
tips: Wear a bandana to reduce honor loss.
Aim to finish during Chapters 2-3; it can also be done after the story.

trophies.name: Cowboy Builder
trophies.description: Complete 'A New Jerusalem'.
howTo: Play the Epilogue and complete 'A New Jerusalem'.

trophies.name: Errand Boy
trophies.description: Deliver 5 camp companion item requests.
trophies.missableDeadline: Before finishing Chapter 4 (treat as missable; see disputes on Epilogue requests).
howTo: Spend time in camp during the day (roughly 8:00-20:00) in Chapters 2-4 and talk to members; some will ask for an item (e.g. Pearson a compass, Mary-Beth a fountain pen, Jack a penny dreadful, Tilly a necklace, Charles oleander, Dutch a pipe).
Find or buy the item and hand it over; repeat until 5 are delivered.
tips: Requests are random and easy to miss if you only return to camp for story missions.

trophies.name: Extreme Personality
trophies.description: Reach maximum or minimum Honor level.
howTo: Cannot unlock before you finish the Chapter 5 mission 'Paradise Mercifully Departed' (PowerPyx; TrueTrophies snippets agree).
Make a manual save first so you can restore your normal honor.
Low route (fastest): commit crimes, kill and loot civilians until the bar reaches the far left.
High route: help strangers, return bounties alive, fish/hunt properly, donate, etc. until the far right.
tips: Do NOT tank honor before Chapter 6's 'Do Not Seek Absolution' is done (needed for Lending a Hand).
Honor gains are boosted in Chapter 6 per community reports.

trophies.name: Friends With Benefits
trophies.description: Complete a Companion Activity in each camp.
trophies.missableDeadline: One activity in the Chapter 2 camp (Horseshoe Overlook) before Chapter 2 ends, one in the Chapter 3 camp (Clemens Point) before Chapter 3 ends, one in the Chapter 4 camp (Shady Belle) before Chapter 4 ends.
howTo: At each camp, look for companion activity map icons or companions offering an outing (e.g. Chapter 2: Charles hunting, Javier home robbery; Chapter 3: Sean or Bill coach robbery, Javier or Kieran fishing; Chapter 4: Uncle cattle robbery, Pearson hunting).
Complete one activity per chapter camp - doing several in one chapter does not make up for a missed chapter.
If nothing shows up, sleep or wait in camp to advance time.
tips: Do one as soon as you reach each new camp.
Progress can be checked via Rockstar Social Club stats (per PowerPyx).

trophies.name: Give to the Poor
trophies.description: Donate $250 to the gang tithing box.
trophies.missableDeadline: Before finishing Chapter 4 (the tithing box is only usable in Chapters 2-4).
howTo: At camp, interact with the tithing box (ledger) and donate cash; donations add up across visits.
Reach $250 total before the end of Chapter 4.
tips: Direct cash donations are the most reliable; PowerPyx says valuables you contribute also count, other sources recommend cash.
Only your own donations count, not other gang members'.

trophies.name: Grin and Bear it
trophies.description: Survive 18 bear attacks and kill the bear each time in Story Mode.
howTo: Go to the area between Wallace Station and Watson's Cabin (north of Little Creek River), a common grizzly spawn.
Equip a strong repeater or shotgun with express ammo.
Let the bear knock you down, mash the escape prompt, then shoot it from the ground during the prompt until it dies - kills done any other way don't count.
Respawn bears by leaving the area (e.g. train to Saint Denis and back), camping and sleeping, or reloading the save; repeat 18 times.
tips: Can take several hours depending on spawn luck.

trophies.name: Hobby Horse
trophies.description: Play all mini games.
howTo: Play (join) one game each of Poker, Blackjack, Dominoes and Five Finger Fillet; you do not need to win.
Example locations from PowerPyx: Five Finger Fillet in Strawberry, Blackjack in the Rhodes saloon, Dominoes in a Saint Denis park, Poker in a Saint Denis saloon.
Check Pause > Progress > Total Completion > Table Games.

trophies.name: It was THIS Big!
trophies.description: Catch a fish weighing at least 16 lbs (7.3 kg).
howTo: Catch any fish of 16 lb or more; legendary fish (fishing rod + legendary lure) guarantee it.

trophies.name: It's Art
trophies.description: Find a permanent home for the squirrel statue.
howTo: Complete all 5 hunting requests (posters in train stations) by mailing perfect carcasses; the last request only unlocks after Epilogue Part 1.
Visit Ms. Hobbs east of Strawberry to receive the squirrel statue.

Place it on the living-room fireplace at Beecher's Hope, sleep, and find it after it goes missing: main bedroom chest, main bedroom chimney, chest in loft above kitchen, wheelbarrow by the barn, chest on barn upper floor, then Mount Shann north of Strawberry.
Put it back each time until the trophy unlocks.

trophies.name: Just a Scratch
trophies.description: Complete 'Enter, Pursued by a Memory'.
howTo: Continue the main story; the trophy pops on finishing 'Enter, Pursued by a Memory'.

trophies.name: Locked and Loaded
trophies.description: Upgrade each available component for a single sidearm or longarm weapon.
howTo: Save manually, visit a gunsmith (e.g. Valentine) and open Customize for one weapon (PowerPyx uses the Double-Action Revolver as the example).
Change each component slot once: grip, barrel length, barrel rifling and sights. You do not need to buy every variant of each slot.
The trophy pops once every slot on that gun has been changed; reload the save afterwards if you want the money back.

trophies.name: No Traitors
trophies.description: Complete Chapter 5.
howTo: Finish Chapter 5.

trophies.name: Paying Respects
trophies.description: Find the graves of each of your fallen companions.
howTo: After the story, visit and interact with each of 9 graves: Hosea and Lenny (together, Bluewater Marsh area north of Saint Denis), Sean (hill by Flat Iron Lake NW of Rhodes), Kieran (meadow west of Shady Belle, south of Bolger Glade), Susan (hill above the railroad south-west of Elysian Pool), Arthur (hilltop south-east of the Mysterious Hill Home, east of Bacchus Station), Eagle Flies (west side of Donner Falls), Davey (Colter), Jenny (near Glacier / Spider Gorge).
Order doesn't matter.

trophies.name: Pony Up
trophies.description: Spend $5000 across all shops.
howTo: Make a manual save, then spend money at stables, gunsmiths, general stores, tailors etc.
Optionally reload the save afterwards to get the money back once the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Self Sufficient
trophies.description: Craft 30 unique items in Story Mode.
howTo: Craft many different recipes: ammo types, tonics, cooked meats, horse items, weapons like arrows, etc., via the camp/satchel crafting menu.

trophies.name: Settling Feuds
trophies.description: Complete Chapter 3.
howTo: Finish Chapter 3. Before doing so, complete a Chapter 3 camp companion activity and the Chapter 3 honor missions.

trophies.name: Skin Deep
trophies.description: Skin every species of animal in Story Mode.
howTo: Kill and skin every skinnable species; track in Pause > Progress > Compendium > Animals.
Guarma-only species are not required; small plucked/picked-up animals are not needed.
tips: Study each animal with binoculars before killing it to progress Zoologist at the same time.
Skin the Green Iguana on the largest island in Flat Iron Lake.
Farm snakes in the swamp around Shady Belle.

trophies.name: Take From the Rich
trophies.description: Rob or loot $250.
howTo: Loot the bodies of enemies you kill in missions and encounters and do robberies; cash totals accumulate to $250.

trophies.name: Third Time Lucky
trophies.description: Complete 'Goodbye, Dear Friend'.
howTo: Progress through Chapter 6 (Beaver Hollow) and complete 'Goodbye, Dear Friend'.

trophies.name: To Greener Pastures
trophies.description: Complete Chapter 2.
howTo: Finish Chapter 2 of the story. Before doing so, make sure Chapter 2 missables are done (a Chapter 2 camp companion activity, Chapter 2 honor missions).

trophies.name: Trusty Steed
trophies.description: Reach max bonding level with a horse.
howTo: Ride, feed, brush, pat and calm the same horse until bonding level 4 (check the Horse screen).
tips: No story trophy requires owning or riding several horse breeds. 'Horses for Courses' is a Red Dead Online trophy. For 100% you only discover any 10 horse breeds in the compendium and reach bonding level 4.

trophies.name: Washed Ashore
trophies.description: Complete Chapter 4.
howTo: Finish Chapter 4. This is the key point of no return: the tithing box, camp item requests and Chapter 4 companion activity must be finished before it.

trophies.name: Western Stranger
trophies.description: Complete 10 Stranger mission strands.
howTo: Complete every part of 10 different Stranger strands (white '?' icons).
Check Pause > Progress > Total Completion > Strangers.
tips: The trophy may pop a little after the 10th strand; keep playing if Social Club shows 10/10.
Single-part/optional strands (All That Glitters, Fundraiser, Help a Brother Out, The Widow of Willard's Rest) do not count per PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Zoologist
trophies.description: Study every animal across all states in Story Mode.
howTo: Use binoculars (or aim) on animals and press the study prompt until the compendium entry registers; variants count separately.
Guarma-only animals are not required (Cuban land crab and green iguana can also be found on the main map).
tips: PowerPyx names Bear Claw, near Manzanita Post, as the best spot for mixed birds and all three common owl types.
If an aggressive animal won't hold still, hit it with a poison throwing knife. It walks off and can then be studied.
Always study first, then kill and skin. This also progresses Skin Deep.

trophies.name: Notorious
trophies.description: Red Dead Online: Reach Rank 50.
howTo: Do the Red Dead Online story missions (Horley/LeClerk line) - good XP and cash.
Complete the Daily Challenges every real-life day (7 per day, ~200 XP each, with streak bonuses).
Play Free Roam missions, Free Roam Events and series; favour kills from horseback, headshots, Dead Eye and special ammo for bonus XP.

Take up the Collector role (buy the Collector's Bag from Madame Nazar with gold bars; watch for discounts), then collect and sell complete collectible sets - each item and set gives XP, and collectibles reset daily.
Check Rockstar's monthly bonus events (e.g. June-Aug 2026: triple XP on bounties and Free Roam Events, +100% XP in a posse) and play the boosted activities.
Track progress under Pause > Progress > Rank Unlocks.
tips: Gold award buckles give XP and some can be reset for repeat XP.
Online trophies such as Buckle Up, Gun For Hire and Eventful come naturally during this grind.
Use a collector map (e.g. jeanropke's RDR2 Collectors Map) for daily collectible routes.

trophies.name: All's Fair
trophies.description: Red Dead Online: Successfully counter a rival Posse's Free Roam mission.
howTo: In public Free Roam, watch for the notification that a nearby player has started a Free Roam mission you can counter (shown in red).
Go to their objective and stop them - e.g. kill the carriage horses or the target - so their mission fails.

Boosting (recommended): have a friend join your session but NOT your posse. They accept a Free Roam mission from a giver standing outdoors (indoor givers reportedly caused a server switch). Once it starts, sabotage it; the trophy pops when it fails.
tips: You do not seem to need to be in a posse yourself.
Takes a few minutes with a friend; can be slow to get naturally with random players.

trophies.name: Breakout
trophies.description: Red Dead Online: Complete the Intro.
howTo: From the RDR2 title screen choose Red Dead Online (or from Story Mode: Pause > Online). No Story Mode progress is required.
Create your character in the prison-wagon/jail sequence and take the mugshot.
Play the opening: Mr. Horley frees you and takes you to Jessica LeClerk's camp; follow the prompts (wardrobe, setting up your camp with Cripps).
Collect the first job at the post office, clear the gang hideout and use the treasure map taken from the last enemy to find the chest (Eagle Eye helps).
Meet Clay Davies for the horse-theft mission and deliver the horse to the Valentine stables.
Return to your camp and speak with Cripps; the trophy unlocks after this cutscene and full Free Roam opens up.
tips: You cannot skip the tutorial; nearly every other online trophy requires finishing it first.

trophies.name: Buckle Up
trophies.description: Red Dead Online: Achieve 5 gold belt buckles from awards.
howTo: Open Pause > Progress > Awards to see the award categories and their bronze/silver/gold tiers.
Reach the gold tier on any 5 awards.
Quick picks: kill a flying bird with an arrow (Hunting), the timed ride-between-towns awards (Travel), sell items to 3 different shop types / spend $1000 in shops (Trade), max horse bond (Horse).
tips: Avoid the Posse category - those awards are long grinds.
Many Sharpshooter awards can be done against AI but are grindy.

trophies.name: Butchered
trophies.description: Red Dead Online: Sell 20 items to the Butcher.
howTo: Hunt and skin animals; pelts, meat, feathers, fat and carcasses all count.
Sell 20 items in total at any Butcher: Valentine, Strawberry, Blackwater, Rhodes, Saint Denis or Tumbleweed.
Track under Pause > Progress > Awards > Trade.
tips: Skinning large animals yields several sellable items at once.

trophies.name: Eventful
trophies.description: Red Dead Online: Play 5 Free Roam Events.
howTo: Play in a public Free Roam session.
When a Free Roam Event invitation appears (purple text on the left of the screen), press the prompted button quickly (Options/Touchpad per the on-screen prompt) to join before it starts.
Stay until the event ends - you do not need to win or even place well.
Repeat for 5 events.
tips: Events trigger periodically (roughly every 45 minutes per older guides); accept every invitation you see.
Participation is enough; do not quit mid-event.
Rockstar monthly bonuses (e.g. June-Aug 2026 triple rewards on Free Roam Events) make these worth doing for XP too.

trophies.name: Getting Started
trophies.description: Red Dead Online: Reach Rank 10.
howTo: Play normally: tutorial, story missions, Free Roam missions, series and daily challenges.
Check progress under Pause > Progress > Rank Unlocks.

trophies.name: Gun For Hire
trophies.description: Red Dead Online: Accept 10 Free Roam missions from characters (around the world).
howTo: In Free Roam, look for the small orange circle mission-giver icons on the map (usually in or near towns).
Walk up to the character and accept their Free Roam mission; complete it.
Repeat until 10 are done. To be safe, take missions from several different givers.
Track progress under Pause > Progress > Awards > Free Roam.
tips: Missions can be done solo.
Some givers only offer one mission at a time; move on to another town if an icon is missing.

trophies.name: Home Comforts
trophies.description: Red Dead Online: Purchase 5 camp improvements.
howTo: Go to your camp and talk to Cripps; open the camp upgrades/customisation menu.
Buy 5 camp improvements with dollars ($). The cheapest are the different coloured camp flags at $50 each.
PowerPyx notes that some players only got it by buying all 5 in one go without leaving the menu - do that to be safe.
If it does not pop after 5, buy a 6th different improvement.
tips: Do NOT buy any camp improvement with gold bars - gold purchases reportedly don't count and may bug the trophy for that character (PSNProfiles lists it as 'buggy').
Some upgrades are rank-locked; flags are available early.

trophies.name: Horses for Courses
trophies.description: Red Dead Online: Concurrently own 5 horses.
howTo: Visit any stable; the first stall is free.
Buy the 4 extra stalls: $100, $150, $500, $750 ($1,500 total; gold-bar prices also exist).
Fill all 5 stalls with horses - the cheapest is the Kentucky Saddler at $50 each - or with horses you break/claim yourself.
The trophy unlocks when 5 horses are owned at the same time.
tips: Save up and buy stalls/horses together; each owned horse adds to the stable upkeep.
Stall prices are from 2019 guides; Rockstar may have changed them - see disputes.

trophies.name: Master Craftsman
trophies.description: Red Dead Online: Craft 20 items (excluding ammo).
howTo: Hunt a few animals and keep the meat.
At a campfire (your camp's fire or one you set up), open crafting and cook meat - plain or with herbs.
Cook until 20 non-ammo items are crafted. PowerPyx reports cooking and eating a piece counts as 2 while stowing counts as 1.
Track under Pause > Progress > Awards > Survivalist.

trophies.name: Non-Regulation
trophies.description: Red Dead Online: Craft 25 pieces of ammunition.
howTo: Buy an ammunition recipe pamphlet from a Fence. Easiest: Split Point ammo pamphlet (unlocks at Rank 28; needs only regular bullets to craft). Alternative: Small Game Arrow pamphlet (Rank 22; needs arrows, shotgun shells and flight feathers).
Go to a campfire, hold the crafting prompt and open the Ammo tab.
Craft the same ammo type repeatedly until 25 pieces are made.
Track under Pause > Progress > Awards > Survivalist.
tips: Carry at least 25 normal rounds of a matching calibre before crafting Split Point.
You will reach Rank 28 on the way to Notorious anyway.

trophies.name: Picked to Perfection
trophies.description: Red Dead Online: Pick 25 Herbs.
howTo: Pick any 25 plants in Red Dead Online - herbs, berries, mushrooms and flowers all count.
Use Eagle Eye (click L3 + R3) to highlight pickable plants.
Track under Pause > Progress > Awards > Survivalist.

trophies.name: Posse Up
trophies.description: Red Dead Online: Form a Persistent Posse.
howTo: Save $200 (normal set-up fee).
Press d-pad left (Player Menu) > Posse > Form Posse.
Set the posse type to Persistent (not Temporary), name it and confirm.
The trophy pops immediately even if you are the only member.
tips: Rockstar periodically waives the Persistent Posse set-up fee in monthly events (e.g. a waiver ran from 30 Jun 2026 to 3 Aug 2026).
The $200 is not refunded if you disband the posse.

trophies.name: Series Major
trophies.description: Red Dead Online: Take part in a Series.
howTo: Finish the tutorial (Breakout).
Open Pause > Online and pick any Series playlist (Showdown Series, Race Series or the weekly Featured Series), or use the Player Menu (d-pad left) > Quick Join.
Play the series to the end; the trophy pops after the match results, not on joining.
tips: Any series type counts, including races.
Stay for the whole match - quitting early does not count.
This also counts toward The Real Deal attempts, so play series where MVP is achievable.

trophies.name: Strength in Numbers
trophies.description: Red Dead Online: Complete a Free Roam mission as part of a Posse with at least 2 members.
howTo: Press d-pad left > Posse > Form Posse (a free Temporary posse is fine) and invite a friend or a player in your session, or use Pause > Online > Posse Up to join a random posse.
With the posse formed, start and complete any Free Roam mission (orange icon).
tips: Needs one other real player; it cannot be done strictly solo.
Combine with All's Fair boosting sessions or look for helpers on community boards.

trophies.name: The Real Deal
trophies.description: Red Dead Online: Achieve MVP 3 times (in a round with at least 4 players).
howTo: Join Series playlists (Pause > Online) with at least 4 players in the lobby.

Solo option A - territory modes (Hostile Territory / Takeover / flag-capture style series): capture a point near your spawn and stay inside it as long as possible; MVP is often awarded for time holding points even if your team loses or you have few kills.

Solo option B - Race Series: MVP almost always goes to the race winner. In Open Races learn a checkpoint route (Tumbleweed and Saint Denis/Rhodes are recommended); in standard races hang back to avoid the opening pile-up, then catch up.
Solo option C - Hardcore series (free aim, no ability cards/tonics) levels the field against veterans.
Boosting: form a group of 4 friends, queue a less-populated series (e.g. a Deathmatch-type or Elimination playlist) so the lobby fills with just your group, and take turns winning.
tips: The MVP award is decided by the game's overall performance score, not purely kills or winning; the MVP can be on the losing team.
Real 2025 reports: MVP obtained in about 15 games by sprinting to capture points; 2 from races + 1 from Hostile Territory by camping an objective.
The older TrueTrophies 'Call to Arms' posse boosting method reportedly no longer works (cooldown patched, comment Dec 2023).
Some playlists (e.g. Elimination) have thin lobbies in 2025 - pick popular or weekly Featured Series for solo attempts.
