trackers.title: Challenges
description: All 90 challenges count toward 100% completion (Best in the West). Within a category they unlock in order, and progress made before a challenge unlocks does not count.
Check Pause > Progress > Challenges in game for live counts.

items.label: Bandit 1: Hold up 5 townsfolk.
items.detail:
Tip: The hold-ups must take place inside town limits; unarmed civilians are the easiest targets.
Tip: Robbing the pickpockets that try to rob you (random encounter) counts and costs no Honor.

items.label: Bandit 2: Rob any 2 coaches, or return any 2 stolen coaches to the Fence.
items.detail:
Tip: Easiest: steal a wagon/coach off the road and drive it to the wagon fence at Emerald Ranch.
Tip: Stagecoach lockboxes can be opened with a lockpick or by shooting the lock.

items.label: Bandit 3: Rob the cash register in any 4 shops in one day.
items.detail:
Tip: Pair towns that are close together, e.g. the shops of Valentine and Rhodes, or Valentine plus Wallace Station.
Tip: Do not load a save between the robberies or the day's count is lost.
Tip: Expect a bounty; wear a mask to reduce identification.

items.label: Bandit 4: Rob any 3 coaches, or return any 3 stolen coaches to the Fence, in one day.
items.detail:
Tip: Same methods as Bandit 2 - wagons around Emerald Ranch make this quick.
Tip: Do not reload a save between the three.

items.label: Bandit 5: Amass a $250 bounty in one state.
items.detail:
Tip: Train robberies and killing lawmen raise a bounty quickly.
Tip: Pay the bounty off at a post office afterwards.

items.label: Bandit 6: Steal 5 horses and sell them to the Horse Fence at Clemens Cove.
items.detail:
Needs: The Clemens Cove horse fence only opens after the Chapter 3 mission 'Horse Flesh for Dinner'.
Tip: Any horses work; a stagecoach team can yield several horses at once.
Tip: Clemens Cove is in Lemoyne, north-east of Rhodes.

items.label: Bandit 7: Rob $50 worth of cash and valuables from townsfolk and travellers.
items.detail:
Tip: Most people carry very little; well-dressed people in Saint Denis carry more.
Tip: Robbing train passengers (e.g. the train near the suspension bridge at Riggs Station) is a quick source.
Tip: Takes a while - fold it in with Bandit 10 train robberies.

items.label: Bandit 8: Steal 7 wagons and sell them to the Fence at Emerald Ranch.
items.detail: Tip: Plenty of wagons travel the roads near Emerald Ranch; take one and drive it straight to the wagon fence.

items.label: Bandit 9: Hogtie someone and leave them on the railroad tracks 3 times.
items.detail:
Tip: The victim does not need to be hit by a train - tie, place on the tracks, and it counts.
Tip: Victims can be ordinary townsfolk or enemies; use three separate victims.

items.label: Bandit 10: Complete 5 train robberies without dying or being caught.
items.detail:
Tip: Minimal robbery: buy a ticket, board, rob one passenger (or loot the cargo), then get off and escape.
Tip: Dying or being caught during the robbery means it does not count.

items.label: Explorer 1: Find a treasure map.
items.detail:
Tip: The Explorer category effectively starts when you pick up your first treasure map.
Tip: Easiest early map: the Jack Hall Gang map from the treasure hunter Maximo near Flatneck Station (buy it, Chapter 2+).

items.label: Explorer 2: Find a treasure (any treasure-hunt stage counts, including a follow-up map).
items.detail:
Needs: A treasure map in your satchel.
Tip: Jack Hall Gang stage 1: Caliban's Seat (rock crevice reached by ledges).

items.label: Explorer 3: Find a treasure (next treasure-hunt stage).
items.detail: Tip: Jack Hall Gang stage 2: Cotorra Springs, in the middle of a rectangle of stones near the geysers.

items.label: Explorer 4: Find a treasure (next treasure-hunt stage).
items.detail: Tip: Jack Hall Gang final stage: small island at O'Creagh's Run, under a small rock (2 gold bars).

items.label: Explorer 5: Find a treasure (next treasure-hunt stage).
items.detail: Tip: Start the Poisonous Trail hunt: its first map is in a lockbox under the bed in Cairn Lodge in the snowy north-west (Chapter 2+). Its stages: a hillside with dead trees (map in a tree), a hilltop stone formation (map in the centre), then the cave behind the Elysian Pool waterfall (bring a lantern).

items.label: Explorer 6: Find a treasure (next treasure-hunt stage).
items.detail: Tip: Continue the Poisonous Trail hunt (stage 2).

items.label: Explorer 7: Find a treasure (next treasure-hunt stage).
items.detail: Tip: Poisonous Trail final stage: Elysian Pool waterfall cave (4 gold bars).

items.label: Explorer 8: Find a treasure (next treasure-hunt stage).
items.detail:
Needs: High Stakes map availability from Chapter 3 is single-source (ppx-treasure).
Tip: High Stakes hunt: map comes from a random treasure-hunter encounter (Chapter 3+, lasso and hogtie him) or can be bought from a fence later. Stage 1: behind Cumberland Falls, reached via a log.

items.label: Explorer 9: Find a treasure (next treasure-hunt stage).
items.detail: Tip: High Stakes stage 2: Barrow Lagoon, on a broken stump between rocks.

items.label: Explorer 10: Find a treasure (next treasure-hunt stage).
items.detail:
Tip: High Stakes final stage: rock crevice on a cliff ledge near Bacchus Station (3 gold bars).
Tip: Any three full treasure hunts (9 finds) complete Explorer 2-10; the order of hunts does not matter.

items.label: Gambler 1: Win 5 hands of Poker.
items.detail:
Tip: Wins do not need to be consecutive. Poker tables: Valentine, Flatneck Station, Saint Denis.
Tip: Flatneck Station has lower stakes.

items.label: Gambler 2: In Blackjack, double down and win the hand 5 times.
items.detail:
Tip: Double down (take exactly one more card) when your starting total is low enough that one card cannot bust you, e.g. 9-11.
Tip: Luck based; save before sitting down.

items.label: Gambler 3: Win 3 games of Five Finger Fillet.
items.detail:
Tip: Wins need not be consecutive. The first-round opponent at each table is easiest (only two buttons).
Tip: Tables: Valentine, Strawberry, Van Horn. If no opponent is present, rent a room and sleep.

items.label: Gambler 4: Bust out one Poker opponent in each of Flatneck Station, Saint Denis and Valentine.
items.detail:
Tip: You must be the one who takes the last chips of a player who went all-in.
Tip: Save before sitting down and go all-in to speed things up.

items.label: Gambler 5: Win 3 rounds of Dominoes without drawing any tiles, against 2 or fewer opponents.
items.detail:
Tip: Dominoes is played in Saint Denis; pick a table with only 1-2 opponents.
Tip: Play doubles early; outcome is largely random.

items.label: Gambler 6: Beat the Blackjack dealer in Rhodes and in Van Horn.
items.detail: Tip: One winning hand at each location is enough.

items.label: Gambler 7: Beat the Five Finger Fillet player in every location (Strawberry, Valentine, Van Horn).
items.detail: Tip: Beat the easy first-round opponent at each of the three tables.

items.label: Gambler 8: Win 3 hands of Blackjack with three hits or more.
items.detail:
Tip: Pure luck: bet the minimum, keep hitting small cards and save after each qualifying win.
Tip: Can take anywhere from minutes to hours.

items.label: Gambler 9: Win 3 games of Dominoes in a row.
items.detail:
Tip: Play the All Fives variant in Saint Denis.
Tip: Getting up from the table between games resets the streak.

items.label: Gambler 10: Win 3 hands of Poker in a row.
items.detail:
Tip: Aggressive large bets/all-ins make opponents fold quickly.
Tip: Standing up from the table resets the streak; save before sitting.

items.label: Herbalist 1: Pick 6 Yarrow.
items.detail: Tip: Common across New Hanover, e.g. south of Valentine (red flower).

items.label: Herbalist 2: Pick and eat 4 species of berry.
items.detail:
Tip: Accepted berries: Blackberry, Red Raspberry, Evergreen Huckleberry, Wintergreen Berry.
Tip: Wintergreen berry grows north-west of Annesburg, near the Old Tomb west of Deer Cottage; the plant is small.

items.label: Herbalist 3: Craft 7 items using Sage as an ingredient.
items.detail:
Tip: Hummingbird Sage counts (Oleander Sage does not).
Tip: Recipes: Potent Bitters (Sage + Burdock Root) or Potent Horse Stimulant (Sage + Common Bulrush); no pamphlet needed.

items.label: Herbalist 4: Pick 5 mushrooms and feed them to your horse.
items.detail: Tip: Any mushroom species; Parasol or Bay Bolete are common.

items.label: Herbalist 5: Craft 9 items using Indian Tobacco as an ingredient.
items.detail: Tip: Potent Snake Oil uses Indian Tobacco; no pamphlet needed.

items.label: Herbalist 6: Pick 15 different species of herb.
items.detail:
Tip: Only plants picked after the challenge is active count - earlier picks are not retroactive.
Tip: Species-rich areas: Black Bone Forest, Cumberland Forest, the Saint Denis bayou.

items.label: Herbalist 7: Craft and use 5 Special Miracle Tonics.
items.detail:
Needs: The Special Miracle Tonic recipe must be bought from a Fence (GamerGuides: available after 'A Short Walk in a Pretty Town') - single-source detail.
Tip: Each tonic needs 6 Yarrow, 6 Burdock Root and 6 Black or Golden Currant (30 of each for all 5).
Tip: A larger satchel helps carry the ingredients.

items.label: Herbalist 8: Use Oleander to craft 6 poison weapons.
items.detail:
Needs: Throwing knives (steam: after Chapter 2 'Paying a Social Call').
Tip: Poison Throwing Knife = 1 throwing knife + 1 Oleander Sage (needs the pamphlet from a Fence).
Tip: Oleander Sage grows in the swamps around Saint Denis and Rhodes.

items.label: Herbalist 9: Pick one of each species of herb (43 species).
items.detail:
Needs: Epilogue (New Austin access) in practice.
Tip: Picking must happen after the challenge unlocks; earlier picks and looting from corpses do not count.
Tip: Several plants (e.g. Desert Sage, Red Sage, Wild Feverfew, Blackcurrant) grow only in New Austin, so plan this for the Epilogue.
Tip: Orchids count; Algernon Wasp's orchid missions can temporarily turn orchids you still owe him into ordinary flowers.

items.label: Herbalist 10: Season and cook all 11 types of meat.
items.detail:
Tip: Season with Creeping Thyme, Oregano or Wild Mint at a campfire.
Tip: Meats: Big Game, Crustacean, Exotic Bird, Flaky Fish, Game, Mutton, Plump Bird, Pork, Prime Beef, Succulent Fish, Venison.
Tip: Pork, Prime Beef and Venison can be bought from a butcher.

items.label: Horseman 1: Kill 5 rabbits from horseback.
items.detail: Tip: Rabbits are common south of Valentine and around Flatneck Station.

items.label: Horseman 2: Jump over 3 obstacles in 15 seconds.
items.detail: Tip: Fences or small rocks; jumping the same obstacle back and forth works.

items.label: Horseman 3: Ride from Valentine to Rhodes in less than 5 minutes.
items.detail:
Tip: Follow the railroad tracks; do not fall off.
Tip: Horse Stimulant (stables) or calming the horse restores stamina.

items.label: Horseman 4: While mounted, drag a victim for 3300 feet (about 1 km) using your lasso.
items.detail:
Tip: Must start with a living person (townsfolk are fine); they may die during the drag.
Tip: Dismounting or losing the rope resets progress; corpses and animals do not count.

items.label: Horseman 5: Trample 5 animals while on horseback.
items.detail: Tip: Slow animals like pheasants, turkeys, ducks, frogs; the area south of Rhodes works well.

items.label: Horseman 6: Ride from Strawberry to Saint Denis in less than 9 minutes without touching any water.
items.detail:
Tip: Puddles count as water. Follow the train tracks and cross the rail bridge south-east into Saint Denis.
Tip: Use a fast horse plus stimulants; falling off fails the run.

items.label: Horseman 7: Kill 7 enemies from horseback without dismounting.
items.detail:
Tip: Hostile (red) targets only; lawmen count, unarmed civilians do not.
Tip: Story missions with horseback shootouts or gang hideouts work.

items.label: Horseman 8: Kill 9 predators from horseback.
items.detail:
Tip: Alligators in the Lemoyne bayou/swamps (e.g. east of Shady Belle, around Saint Denis) are the fastest option; use Dead Eye.
Tip: Wolves, coyotes, cougars, and even crows/vultures count as predators per one guide.

items.label: Horseman 9: Ride from Van Horn to Blackwater in less than 17 minutes without touching any water.
items.detail:
Needs: PowerPyx: only possible in the Epilogue because Arthur is shot on sight at Blackwater (disputed - see disputes).
Tip: Route: rail bridges past Van Horn and Flatneck, then cross the Owanjila Dam and head south to Blackwater.
Tip: Uncover the map first and carry horse stimulants.

items.label: Horseman 10: Break every wild horse breed.
items.detail:
Tip: Required (9): American Standardbred, American Paint, Appaloosa, Hungarian Halfbred, Kentucky Saddler, Morgan, Mustang, Nokota, Tennessee Walker.
Tip: Not required: Arabian (incl. White Arabian), Thoroughbred, Andalusian, Tiger-Striped Mustang.
Tip: Several spawns are in New Austin or around Blackwater, which are practical only in the Epilogue.

items.label: Master Hunter 1: Skin 3 deer.
items.detail: Tip: Deer are common around the early camps and Valentine.

items.label: Master Hunter 2: Collect 3 perfect quality rabbit pelts.
items.detail:
Tip: Study the rabbit to confirm 3 stars, then headshot with the Varmint Rifle or a small game arrow.
Tip: Trampled or wrong-weapon kills ruin the pelt.

items.label: Master Hunter 3: Track 10 different animal species using your binoculars.
items.detail: Tip: Use the track option while looking through binoculars; horses, domestic animals and flying birds do not count (steam).

items.label: Master Hunter 4: Call an animal and get a clean kill 5 times.
items.detail: Tip: Aim, use the animal call, and kill in one shot before it moves; more than one shot disqualifies.

items.label: Master Hunter 5: Skin 3 black or grizzly bears.
items.detail: Tip: A grizzly reliably spawns west/north-west of Wallace Station; any kill method is fine.

items.label: Master Hunter 6: Kill 5 cougars with your bow, then skin them.
items.detail:
Tip: Considered the hardest Master Hunter task. Cougars roam West Elizabeth near the trapper and the northern mountains.
Tip: Poison arrows remove the need for headshots; stay mounted for escape and save often.

items.label: Master Hunter 7: Use bait to lure and kill both a herbivore and a predator.
items.detail: Tip: Buy or craft herbivore and predator bait; place it away from roads and wait at a distance. Bait only attracts animals already nearby.

items.label: Master Hunter 8: Catch 3 fish without using a fishing rod.
items.detail:
Tip: Shoot fish with small-calibre weapons or a bow, trample them in shallow water, or chase them onto the bank.
Tip: Dynamite destroys the fish so they cannot be picked up (PowerPyx).

items.label: Master Hunter 9: Catch an opossum playing possum.
items.detail:
Tip: Opossums spawn at night, e.g. near Riggs Station or across the tracks east of the first camp.
Tip: Chase it until it falls over faking death, then pick it up (safest) - sources differ on whether killing it also works.

items.label: Master Hunter 10: Find and kill the legendary panther 'Giaguaro'.
items.detail:
Needs: Giaguaro only spawns after Master Hunter 9 is complete.
Tip: Lives in Scarlett Meadows, Lemoyne - east of Braithwaite Manor / south of Bolger Glade, towards Shady Belle.
Tip: Unlike other legendaries it stalks you after you study its tracks; very high health, bring a strong rifle and Dead Eye.

items.label: Sharpshooter 1: Kill 3 flying birds.
items.detail: Tip: Any birds in flight.

items.label: Sharpshooter 2: Kill 2 different species of animal in the same Dead Eye use.
items.detail: Tip: Mixed duck flocks on rivers usually contain two species.

items.label: Sharpshooter 3: Kill 5 flying birds while on a moving train.
items.detail: Tip: Buy a ticket and shoot from the rear platform; jump off afterwards if you draw a bounty.

items.label: Sharpshooter 4: Kill someone at least 80 feet away with a tomahawk.
items.detail:
Needs: Tomahawks (buyable at fence/trapper after an early Chapter 2 mission - see disputes).
Tip: People only, not animals. The reticle turns red when the target is in throwing range.

items.label: Sharpshooter 5: Kill 6 animals without switching or reloading your weapon.
items.detail: Tip: Duck flocks along rivers with a repeater.

items.label: Sharpshooter 6: Kill someone at least 660 feet away with a long scoped rifle.
items.detail:
Tip: Needs a rifle fitted with a long scope (Bolt Action, Carcano, etc.).
Tip: Elevated positions help, e.g. the Hanging Dog Ranch hideout.

items.label: Sharpshooter 7: Get 7 headshots in a row.
items.detail: Tip: People or animals count; a missed or non-lethal headshot breaks the streak.

items.label: Sharpshooter 8: Disarm 3 enemies without reloading or switching your weapon.
items.detail: Tip: Shoot enemies' hands/weapons; Dead Eye tagging hands on 3 enemies works. Use a high-capacity gun.

items.label: Sharpshooter 9: Shoot 3 people's hats off in the same Dead Eye use.
items.detail: Tip: Mark the hats in Dead Eye; one guide suggests a buckshot shotgun aimed just above heads from medium range.

items.label: Sharpshooter 10: Kill 3 flying birds with 3 consecutive long scoped rifle shots.
items.detail: Tip: Any miss resets. You may leave and re-enter the scope between shots.

items.label: Survivalist 1: Catch 3 Bluegill.
items.detail: Tip: Common in rivers, lakes and swamps; cheese bait works.

items.label: Survivalist 2: Hand in 5 animals to camp or a trapper.
items.detail: Tip: Any animal, bird or fish donated to Pearson or sold to a trapper counts.

items.label: Survivalist 3: Kill 5 animals with a Varmint Rifle.
items.detail: Tip: Any small animals, birds or fish.

items.label: Survivalist 4: Craft a dynamite, fire, improved, poison, and small game arrow.
items.detail: Tip: Improved, fire and small game arrows are available from Chapter 2; dynamite and poison arrows need pamphlets from a Fence.

items.label: Survivalist 5: Catch a fish in the Bayou from a boat (PowerPyx wording: riverboat; any small boat such as a rowboat works) and while standing on train tracks.
items.detail:
Tip: Bayou = the swamps around Saint Denis. Boats sit at piers such as Caliga Hall or Lagras.
Tip: The train-track catch must also be in the Bayou region.

items.label: Survivalist 6: Kill a scavenging animal while it is feeding on a corpse, 5 times.
items.detail: Tip: Leave a carcass and kill the scavenger while it is eating; predator bait also counts as a corpse.

items.label: Survivalist 7: Kill 8 small game animals with consecutive shots, using small game arrows.
items.detail:
Tip: One arrow per kill; a miss, a second shot or a too-large animal (e.g. rabbit) resets.
Tip: Rats/bats in the Elysian Pool cave or birds on rocks are good targets.

items.label: Survivalist 8: Craft a homing tomahawk, improved tomahawk, volatile dynamite, and volatile fire bottle.
items.detail: Tip: All four need pamphlets sold by the Fence (stock depends on story progress); ingredients include moonshine, animal fat and bird feathers.

items.label: Survivalist 9: Catch a fish that weighs at least 19 lb.
items.detail: Tip: Muskie (e.g. Lake Isabella), Lake Sturgeon, Northern Pike, Longnose Gar (behind Shady Belle) or Channel Catfish; legendary fish count.

items.label: Survivalist 10: Catch one of each type of fish (15 species).
items.detail: Tip: Small species appear in any suitable water; large species have specific spots. Legendary fish count.

items.label: Weapons Expert 1: Kill 3 enemies with a knife.
items.detail: Tip: Often completes naturally in stealth story missions or at bandit camps.

items.label: Weapons Expert 2: Kill 3 enemies in 10 seconds using only throwing knives.
items.detail:
Needs: Throwing knives (steam: after Chapter 2 'Paying a Social Call').
Tip: Use Dead Eye; gang hideouts or story missions work.

items.label: Weapons Expert 3: Kill 3 birds of prey using only a tomahawk.
items.detail:
Needs: Tomahawks (see disputes for unlock mission).
Tip: Leave a carcass to attract vultures/crows; eagles and hawks land on rocks and rail bridges. Use Eagle Eye to spot them.

items.label: Weapons Expert 4: Kill 10 enemies with a shotgun using crafted ammo.
items.detail: Tip: Craft Incendiary Buckshot (moonshine + shells) or Explosive Slugs (animal fat + slugs) - pamphlets from the Fence.

items.label: Weapons Expert 5: Kill 5 mounted enemies, using 1 throwing knife per kill.
items.detail: Tip: Headshots or poisoned knives; bounty hunters and mounted lawmen are good targets.

items.label: Weapons Expert 6: Kill 4 enemies at the same time with a single stick of dynamite.
items.detail: Tip: Hogtie enemies and pile them together, or use volatile dynamite on a gang camp.

items.label: Weapons Expert 7: Kill 4 consecutive enemies by throwing and retrieving the same tomahawk.
items.detail:
Tip: Throw once into the ground and pick it up before starting; carry only one tomahawk type.
Tip: Firing any other weapon or a non-tomahawk kill resets.

items.label: Weapons Expert 8: Kill 15 enemies using a long-barrelled sidearm.
items.detail:
Tip: Fit a long barrel to a revolver/pistol at a gunsmith (e.g. Volcanic Pistol); kills need not be consecutive.
Tip: Gang hideouts such as Hanging Dog Ranch supply enough enemies.

items.label: Weapons Expert 9: Kill 9 unaware enemies from behind, using the bow.
items.detail: Tip: Stealth at hideouts/bandit camps; retreat until the alert clears, then repeat.

items.label: Weapons Expert 10: Kill a grizzly bear without taking damage, using only throwing knives.
items.detail:
Tip: Grizzlies roam north-west of Wallace Station (black bears do not count).
Tip: Use poisoned or improved throwing knives and Dead Eye headshots.

trackers.title: Cigarette Cards
description: 144 cards in 12 sets of 12. One full set is enough for 100% completion; all 144 (the "Smoking and Other Hobbies" strand) is one of four ways to earn Collector's Item.
Any card can also come from Premium Cigarette packs sold at general stores. No open-licence position data exists for cards, so they have written directions only (no map).

items.label: Steam Locomotive
items.detail: Abandoned church due east of Bolger Glade: sprint-jump up to the upper landing; the card is in a bird's nest by the wall.

items.label: Camera
items.detail: Saint Denis: the building just south of the photo studio, on its balcony.

items.label: Electrical Execution Apparatus
items.detail: Hanging Dog Ranch (north of Little Creek River): upstairs in the house, under the bunk bed.

items.label: Typewriter
items.detail: Blackwater: west of the post office, on a barrel beside the west wall of the big barn/warehouse.

items.label: Revolver
items.detail: Annesburg: on a table at the back of the gunsmith.

items.label: Telegraph
items.detail: Northwest of Van Horn Trading Post at the abandoned train station: on the bench of a stagecoach near the platform.

items.label: Manned Glider
items.detail: Caliga Hall: on the workbench in the middle of the barn west of the mansion.

items.label: Dynamite
items.detail: Shady Belle (south-west of Saint Denis): on the railing of the mansion's back porch.

items.label: Cylinder Phonograph
items.detail: Valentine: on a saloon windowsill facing the street next to the piano (saloon identity disputed - see disputes).

items.label: Player Piano
items.detail: Saint Denis: on top of the piano inside the Bastille Saloon (west side of the city).

items.label: Electric Light Bulb
items.detail: Doverhill, north-west of Brandywine Drop: on a crate near the back door of the facility.

items.label: Fountain Pen
items.detail: Pleasance (north of the 'O' in LEMOYNE): on a desk inside the abandoned schoolhouse.

items.label: Edith Corinne
items.detail: Braithwaite Manor (south of Rhodes): under the table beside the clothesline in the middle of the grounds.

items.label: Elsie Rose
items.detail: Strawberry hotel: on the table at the top of the stairs on the second floor.

items.label: W.G. Hoyt
items.detail: Hani's Bethel (cabin by a small lake above the 'NO' of HANOVER): on a table inside the cabin.

items.label: Aldous Bramley

trackers.title: Exotics (Duchesses and Other Animals)
description: Five delivery lists for the collector in north Saint Denis, opening in Chapter 4. Each list opens after the previous one is handed in. Counts for Collector's Item and 100%.

items.label: Duchesses and other Animals - Request 1
items.detail: Items: 5 Little Egret Plumes, 5 Reddish Egret Plumes, 5 Snowy Egret Plumes, 15 Lady of the Night Orchids. Where: Egrets: daytime (around noon) in the west Bayou Nwa; Lady of the Night grows on trees in Bayou Nwa. Deliver to Algernon Wasp's greenhouse in north Saint Denis to unlock the next list.

items.label: Duchesses and other Animals - Request 2
items.detail: Items: 20 Heron Plumes, 7 Lady Slipper Orchids, 10 Moccasin Flower Orchids. Where: Herons: Bayou Nwa / Bluewater Marsh by day; Lady Slipper on the ground in Big Valley and Tall Trees; Moccasin Flower around Butcher Creek, Roanoke Ridge. Deliver to Algernon Wasp's greenhouse in north Saint Denis to unlock the next list.

items.label: Duchesses and other Animals - Request 3
items.detail: Items: 25 Gator Eggs, 3 Acuna's Star Orchids, 7 Cigar Orchids, 5 Ghost Orchids. Where: Gator nests (3-5 eggs each) near water in the Lemoyne swamps around Shady Belle and the bayou; orchids on trees in the Lemoyne wetlands. Deliver to Algernon Wasp's greenhouse in north Saint Denis to unlock the next list.

items.label: Duchesses and other Animals - Request 4
items.detail: Items: 30 Spoonbill Plumes, 10 Rat Tail Orchids, 5 Spider Orchids, 5 Night Scented Orchids. Where: Spoonbills: Bluewater Marsh / Bayou Nwa around noon; Rat Tail in Bayou Nwa & Bluewater Marsh; Spider around Bayall Edge; Night Scented south-east of Braithwaite Manor / Bolger Glade. Deliver to Algernon Wasp's greenhouse in north Saint Denis to unlock the next list.

items.label: Duchesses and other Animals - Request 5
items.detail: Items: 5 Clamshell Orchids, 5 Queen's Orchids, 10 Sparrow's Egg Orchids, 5 Dragon's Mouth Orchids. Where: Clamshell on the west banks of the Kamassa/Lannahechee west of Saint Denis; Queen's in the swamp between Lagras and Lakay; Sparrow's Egg in Roanoke Ridge between Elysian Pool and Roanoke Valley; Dragon's Mouth in Grizzlies East. Deliver to Algernon Wasp's greenhouse in north Saint Denis to unlock the next list.

trackers.title: Legendary Fish
description: Catch and mail all 13 for Jeremy Gill ("A Fisher of Fish"), needed for 100% completion. A catch of 16 lb or more pops It Was THIS Big! along the way. Channel Catfish and Northern Pike are extras.
Buy the special lures in Lagras first. Map pins mark the fishing AREA only (approximate).

Upper Kamassa River by the waterfall, west of Willard's Rest. Fish from an island in the stream. Lure: Special River Lure.

Elysian Pool, south of Annesburg. Stand on the rocks near the west bank or east of the waterfall. Lure: Special Lake Lure.

trackers.title: Treasure Hunts
description: One full chain is needed for 100%; the Explorer challenges need three chains (Jack Hall Gang, Poisonous Trail, High Stakes).

items.label: Jack Hall Gang - start
items.detail: Buy the map from Maximo Cristobal Valdespino west of Flatneck Station / south-west of Horseshoe Overlook ('All That Glitters'); decline $10 so he drops to $5. If lost, buy it from a fence.

items.label: Jack Hall Gang - clue 1
items.detail: Caliban's Seat: climb up, take the path down the right-hand side, jump across ledges to a crevice in the rock wall.

items.label: Jack Hall Gang - clue 2
items.detail: Cotorra Springs among the geysers: under the central rock/stone pile of the rectangular arrangement (wiki: the largest rock at the top - circle it until the prompt appears).

items.label: Jack Hall Gang - treasure
items.detail: O'Creagh's Run: swim to the small island; loose rock on its south side hides 2 gold bars.

items.label: Poisonous Trail - start
items.detail: Cairn Lodge at Cairn Lake (far north-west): lockbox under the bed next to the door.

items.label: Poisonous Trail - clue 1
items.detail: Scarlett Meadows near Face Rock, west of Ringneck Creek, north-west of Hill Haven Ranch: in the base of a hollow/dead tree halfway up a hill.

items.label: Poisonous Trail - clue 2
items.detail: Serpent Mound, lower Roanoke Ridge west of Van Horn: in the hole at the centre of the oval stone formation at the mound's west end.

items.label: Poisonous Trail - treasure
items.detail: Elysian Pool waterfall cave: bring a lantern, drop down on the right, crawl through the gap and hug the right wall to the tunnel end; 4 gold bars.

items.label: High Stakes - start
items.detail: Random treasure hunter encounter between Diablo Ridge and Riggs Station; hogtie/knock him down (or kill) for the map, or buy it from a fence if you let him go several times.

items.label: High Stakes - clue 1
items.detail: Behind the Cumberland Falls waterfall (walk up the log on the right side).

items.label: High Stakes - clue 2
items.detail: Barrow Lagoon (frozen lake north-west of Valentine): in the log/broken tree between the island and shore.

items.label: High Stakes - treasure
items.detail: Ridge between Fort Wallace and Bacchus Station above the river: drop ledge to ledge down the cliff side (above a rock carving) to a crevice; 3 gold bars.

issues.details: PowerPyx's page lists the requirement as a long-barrelled shotgun; the others say sidearm.

positions.claim: Kill 15 enemies using a long-barrelled shotgun
Kill 15 enemies using a long-barrelled sidearm (revolver/pistol)

issues.handling: Use 'long-barrelled sidearm' (majority wording, matches the in-game text quoted in video titles). Tell players to fit a long barrel to a revolver or pistol.

issues.details: Most sources list 9 required breeds; the Steam guide says 10.

positions.claim: 9 breeds (Arabian, Thoroughbred, Andalusian, Tiger-Striped Mustang not needed)

issues.handling: List the 9 breeds and tell players to watch the in-game checklist under the challenge for any remaining breed.

issues.details: PowerPyx says Van Horn to Blackwater is only doable in the Epilogue because Arthur is shot on sight near Blackwater. Fandom (via search summary) says every challenge except Herbalist 9 is possible as Arthur. The Steam guide mentions lawmen near Blackwater but does not rule it out.
issues.handling: Recommend doing Horseman 9 in the Epilogue. Arthur may be able to finish it, but it is risky.

issues.topic: Master Hunter 9 - kill or capture the opossum
issues.details: Sources differ on the final action once the opossum plays dead.

positions.claim: Shoot it while it is playing dead
Pick it up while it plays dead

issues.handling: Tell players to chase it until it plays dead and then pick it up. If that fails, shooting it is the fallback.

issues.details: The sources name different Chapter 2 missions for when tomahawks can be bought.

positions.claim: After 'Americans at Rest' (or found early at Six Point Cabin)

issues.handling: Say tomahawks become available during Chapter 2 and check the Fence or trapper stock. Do not name a mission.

issues.details: PowerPyx/Steam only need Rhodes and Van Horn for Gambler 6. GamerGuides also lists Saint Denis and Blackwater for blackjack, and no other source confirms those.

positions.claim: Blackjack at Rhodes and Van Horn

issues.handling: Tell players to use Rhodes and Van Horn only.

issues.details: Only GamerGuides says the Special Miracle Tonic recipe must be bought from a Fence after 'A Short Walk in a Pretty Town'. PowerPyx and Steam give no prerequisite.

positions.claim: Recipe bought from Fence after 'A Short Walk in a Pretty Town'

issues.handling: Mention that the recipe may need to be bought from a Fence (single source).

issues.details: PowerPyx's treasure page notes the Poisonous Trail finale (Elysian Pool cave) is epilogue-accessible but does not clearly say whether it is reachable earlier. No source lists any Explorer challenge as epilogue-only.
issues.handling: Do not mark Explorer as epilogue-only. The High Stakes map needs Chapter 3+.

issues.details: PowerPyx's trophy guide says all four collectible strands (incl. all 144 cards) are needed for 100%, and its checklist line lists '144 Cigarette Cards', while its own checklist text, the in-game task text it quotes, the wiki and RDR2.org say only ONE complete set is needed.

positions.claim: Only 1 complete set of 12 cards is required for 100%

issues.handling: Tell the player 1 set suffices for 100%; all 144 are only needed if they choose cards for Collector's Item (rock carvings are faster).

issues.details: The wiki Dinosaur Bones and Rock Carvings pages claim finding just one item is enough, but the wiki 100% page, PowerPyx and RDR2.org require completing A Test of Faith / Geology for Beginners.

positions.claim: All 30 bones / all 10 carvings (complete the strand)

issues.handling: Require the full strands.

issues.details: Wiki says 'clear 6'; RDR2.org says 'all'; PowerPyx says all 6 (7 exist only in Special/Ultimate editions via Twin Rocks).
issues.handling: Say 6 (all six standard-edition hideouts); Twin Rocks is a bonus only in some editions.

issues.topic: Western Stranger eligibility of A Better World, A New Friend and other wiki-listed strangers
issues.details: PowerPyx's 22-strand list excludes hunting requests, Brothers and Sisters One and All, Of Men and Angels and To the Ends of the Earth, which the wiki lists as stranger missions. TrueTrophies only says multi-part strands count.

positions.claim: 22 eligible strands as listed by PowerPyx
Wiki lists additional stranger missions without stating eligibility

issues.handling: Recommend finishing 12+ strands from the PowerPyx list; do not rely on the unlisted ones.

issues.details: Wiki: crate at the base of Fort Wallace's NW tower (time-limited, Chapter 6). RDR2.org: workbench in a cabin by O'Creagh's Run.
issues.handling: Tell players to buy it from Premium Cigarette packs.

issues.details: Wiki: Smithfield's Saloon windowsill by the piano; RDR2.org: Keane's Saloon, Valentine.
issues.handling: Check the windowsills by the piano in both Valentine saloons, or buy it.

issues.topic: American Standardbred / Missouri Fox Trotter cards
issues.details: Wiki gives the identical spot (boy's bedroom table at Catfish Jackson's) for both; RDR2.org gives two different bedrooms in houses south of Braithwaite Manor by the water/Lannahechee River.

positions.claim: Same table in Catfish Jackson's boy's bedroom
Two different bedrooms of riverside houses south of Braithwaite

issues.handling: Search all bedrooms at Catfish Jackson's; fallback to buying.

issues.details: RDR2.org uses 'Breeds of Horses', 'Fauna/Flora of North America', 'The World's Champion'; the wiki uses 'Horses', 'Fauna/Flora of America', 'World Champions'; PowerPyx abbreviates ('Artists', 'Americans'). Card spellings also differ (Elsie/Elise Rose, George/Georgie Dixie, Richard/Rochard McCullough, Theobaud/Theobald Getzin).
issues.handling: Use wiki spellings (used here); verify against the in-game compendium when possible.

issues.details: Wiki's Marvels of Travel table lists Riggs Station (Stagecoach card) under New Hanover; RDR2.org says West Elizabeth.
issues.handling: Recorded as West Elizabeth; merge agent may verify with map data.

issues.topic: Dreamcatcher near The Loft / Annesburg cluster
issues.details: Wiki puts the Grizzlies East dreamcatcher south-west of The Loft, GamesRadar south-east. Three Annesburg-area dreamcatchers (wiki #11, #12, #14) could not be matched one-to-one to GamesRadar descriptions.
issues.handling: Use map pins from the coordinate agent; wording kept generic ('downhill from The Loft').

issues.details: Wiki and GamesRadar number bones differently; Ambarino #3 and New Hanover #11/#12 and New Austin #5 descriptions differ in landmark and are marked single-source.
issues.handling: Rely on coordinate dataset pins for these four.

issues.topic: Duchesses and other Animals cash reward total
issues.details: Total cash: wiki $750 vs PowerPyx $760.
issues.handling: Do not state an exact cash total.

issues.details: PowerPyx: Chapter 3 after 'The New South'. Wiki: after triggering All That Glitters (meeting Maximo).
issues.handling: Tell players to meet Maximo first and look for the hunter from Chapter 3 on.

issues.details: Several cards are in Blackwater (Typewriter, Aldous Bramley, Evelyn Miller, Black Belle, Sadie Russell, Blackwater vista). Whether Arthur can safely collect them before the Epilogue was not verified in this research.
issues.handling: No availableFrom set; buying cards avoids the issue.

issues.details: RDOMap singleplayer.json has 20 dreamcatcher points; RDOMap discoverables.json overlay layer has 21 dreamcatcher icons. The extra overlay icon has no match within 0.1 map units in singleplayer.json: raw lat=-75.5195, lng=95.4003 -> game (-1023.8, -768.0).
issues.handling: Use the 20 singleplayer.json points (matches the known set size of 20). Do not pin the extra overlay icon.

issues.details: Jeremy Gill's 'A Fisher of Fish' needs 13 legendary fish; the Legendary Channel Catfish unlocks after mailing those (14 total per Fextralife). RDR2.org also lists the Legendary Northern Pike (obtained separately), and RDOMap's story overlay has 15 fish icons including both.
issues.handling: Show all 15 pins but label Channel Catfish and Northern Pike as extras outside the 13 needed for 'A Fisher of Fish'.

issues.details: RDOMap's runtime map.js and bounty scripts use +111.29; an older dev script (dev/scripts/port-source-coords-to-website-coords.js) uses +111.294. The difference is 0.004 map units = about 0.26 game units in X.
issues.handling: Use 111.29 (the live site constant); the difference is negligible at any map zoom.

issues.details: PowerPyx and DamnModz list only 4 missables but warn homesteads are limited and can be lost; GamerGuides counts Breaking and Entering as a 5th missable and advises doing it in Chapters 2-3.

positions.claim: Not officially missable, but homesteads can become unavailable; be careful.
Treat as missable; complete 4 stashes during Chapters 2 or 3.

issues.handling: Place it in the route as a soft-missable: rob 4 homesteads in Chapters 2-3 with a save before each, never kill homestead owners you haven't robbed.

issues.topic: Exact honor requirement for Do Not Seek Absolution
issues.details: PowerPyx/DamnModz state Honor level 4 of 8; GamerGuides says only 'high honor'; Games-Guides says at least half the bar on the right (white) side.

positions.claim: At least halfway on the white side of the honor bar.

issues.handling: Tell the player to be at 4/8 or higher (ideally max) before starting Chapter 6 optional missions; these descriptions are consistent (4/8 = halfway).

issues.details: Most guides say before the end of Chapter 4; one search-snippet source said 'before Chapter 6'.

positions.claim: Only Chapters 2-4; finish before Chapter 4 ends.

issues.handling: Use end of Chapter 4 ('Banking, the Old American Art') as the hard deadline; aim for Chapter 2.

issues.topic: Lending a Hand workaround still working
issues.details: PowerPyx documents replaying 'Home Improvement for Beginners' post-game as unlocking the trophy (patch 1.03, credit Reddit user). A search snippet claims a user confirmed it in April 2026, but no source was directly verified on the current PS4/PS5 build.

positions.claim: Replaying 'Home Improvement for Beginners' after the story unlocks Lending a Hand regardless of missed missions.
Optional missions replayed from the story log do not count toward the trophy (only the workaround mission does).

issues.handling: Route all honor missions normally; mention the workaround only as a last-resort fallback that may be patched.

issues.topic: Which Guarma animals are exclusive / Fer-de-Lance
issues.details: PowerPyx lists 8 Guarma-exclusive species including the Fer-de-Lance snake; Codeberg lists 7 (Blue & Yellow, Great Green, Scarlet Macaw, Rainbow, Red-tailed, Sunglow Boa, Red-footed Booby) and omits Fer-de-Lance. Both agree none are required for trophies.
issues.handling: State that no Guarma animal is needed for Zoologist/Skin Deep; optionally study all snakes/birds on Guarma for completeness.

issues.details: Codeberg lists studying the Carolina Parakeet as missable; an RDR2.org forum user reports it was not needed for Zoologist; PowerPyx's animal guide lists it as a normal bayou animal without a missable warning.

positions.claim: Missable compendium entry - study before it disappears.
Listed as a regular Lemoyne bayou animal, no warning.

issues.handling: Tell the player to study one during Chapters 3-6 in the bayou as insurance.

issues.topic: Do table games with gang members count as companion activities?
issues.details: Codeberg lists Lenny/Micah Five Finger Fillet and Tilly Dominoes among 'companion activities'; PowerPyx says table games with gang members do not count for Friends With Benefits.

positions.claim: Table games don't count for the trophy.
Listed as companion activities in the missables checklist.

issues.handling: Instruct the player to do a hunting/robbery/fishing activity each chapter; don't rely on table games.

issues.details: PowerPyx roadmap says 48 of 62 weapons; PowerPyx 100% guide says 48 of 59.
issues.handling: Only state the 48 requirement.

issues.details: PowerPyx lists it as a Chapter 2 optional honor mission; Codeberg says it stays available until the end of Chapter 5.
issues.handling: Route it in Chapter 2.

issues.details: Chapters 2 and 3 are non-linear; guides list missions in different orders.

positions.claim: PowerPyx order (used here): Polite Society, Americans at Rest, Exit Pursued, Paying a Social Call, A Quiet Time, Who is Not without Sin, Spines of America, Money Lending, Blessed are the Meek?, First Shall Be Last, Pouring Forth Oil, ... A Strange Kindness last.
Other guides use orders such as Who is Not without Sin third, or The New South before Further Questions of Female Suffrage in Chapter 3.

issues.handling: Show order as a recommendation. Only fixed points: Polite Society first; The Sheep and the Goats, then A Strange Kindness, end Chapter 2; Blood Feuds, then The Battle of Shady Belle, end Chapter 3.

issues.topic: Accuracy percentages in some medal requirements
issues.details: GamesHedge gives 75% instead of 70% (Blessed are the Meek?, The Sheep and the Goats, American Distillation, Preaching Forgiveness, Sodom? Back to Gomorrah) and 80% instead of 85% (Further Questions of Female Suffrage, Blood Feuds).
issues.handling: Use the PowerPyx values (70% / 85%), which three sources back. Tell players to aim above 85% anyway.

issues.topic: Which mission parts have gold medals / total gold-medal missions
issues.details: GTABase marks grouped entries (Money Lending I & II, Pouring Forth Oil I & II, etc.) as having gold objectives and says 105 missions have gold medals. rdr2.org says Money Lending has no gold medal, and PowerPyx counts 104.

positions.claim: 104 gold-medal missions; Money Lending I/II/IV and the first parts of multi-part missions have no medal

issues.handling: Use 104 and mark the listed parts as 'no medal'. The gold count needed for the trophy is 70 either way.

issues.topic: Total story missions in game and per-chapter counts
issues.details: Guides count multi-part missions differently.

positions.claim: 104 story missions for 100% (and Ch2 = 18, Ch3 = 17 medal missions)
110 story missions incl. 19 optional honour missions; Ch2 = 19 and Ch3 = 18 entries (grouped)

issues.handling: Enforce only the gold-medal counts (6 / 18 / 17 = 41 for Ch1-3). Present the story-mission total as 'about 104 (counting varies)'.

issues.topic: Exit Pursued by a Bruised Ego objectives
issues.details: rdr2.org lists only the 12-minute and 6-shots objectives.

positions.claim: Three objectives incl. 'Track the bear within 1:30'

issues.handling: Show all three objectives.

issues.topic: Wording of A Quiet Time objectives
issues.details: rdr2.org paraphrases 'make amends' as interacting with Tommy several times in the saloon.

positions.claim: Make amends with an old rival; catch Lenny in the act; don't get arrested
Interact with Tommy four times; avoid arrest

issues.handling: Use the PowerPyx wording, and add the Tommy tip as how to do it.

issues.details: Sources give different cut-off missions.

positions.claim: Ch2 deadline 'The Sheep and the Goats'; Ch3 deadline 'Blood Feuds, Ancient and Modern' for companion activities, requests, Money Lending IV and True Love
The Course of True Love before 'A Short Walk in a Pretty Town'; Sean coach robbery before 'Blessed are the Peacemakers'
Before the chapter's final group of missions

issues.handling: Use the earliest deadline: finish Ch2 extras before The Sheep and the Goats, and Ch3 extras before Blessed are the Peacemakers.

issues.details: Most givers and start locations come only from rdr2.org summaries. Some (e.g. Horse Flesh for Dinner: Tavish Gray; American Distillation: Rhodes sheriff's office; Who is Not without Sin: Flatneck Station) were not cross-checked.
issues.handling: Show the mission icon's chapter camp as the default start. Treat named givers as secondary info.

issues.topic: Pouring Forth Oil II listed as missable
issues.details: Codeberg lists Pouring Forth Oil II among Chapter 2 missable missions, but PowerPyx says The Sheep and the Goats unlocks after Pouring Forth Oil IV, which suggests the chain is required.

positions.claim: Pouring Forth Oil II is missable
The Pouring Forth Oil chain leads into the chapter finale (GTABase marks only I & II as optional)

issues.handling: Tell players to finish all Pouring Forth Oil parts in Chapter 2.

issues.topic: Total gold medal missions: 104 vs 105 (High and Low Finance)
issues.details: Special/Ultimate Edition companion mission 'High and Low Finance' (Charles bank robbery, Chapter 4) has gold objectives. GTABase counts 105 medal missions; PowerPyx and the Steam guide count 104 and the Steam guide states it does not count toward 'Gold Rush'. A PowerPyx commenter says it appears in the Chapter 4 story tab.

positions.claim: 104 medal missions; HLF does not count toward the 70
105 missions have gold objectives including HLF

issues.handling: Show 104 as the trophy-relevant total and list HLF separately as an optional Special Edition extra that may not count.

issues.details: PowerPyx lists 'Horsemen, Apocalypse', 'American Fathers - II', 'Fatherhood and Other Dreams - II', 'Mrs. Sadie Adler, Widow - II', 'The Course of True Love - V', 'Bare Knuckles Friendships', 'That's Murfee Country'. Fandom/Steam use 'Horsemen, Apocalypses', 'Bare Knuckle Friendships', 'That's Murfree Country' and describe the multi-part missions as I & II / IV & V where only the later part carries the medal.
issues.handling: Use fandom spellings; note that the medal belongs to the final part (II or V) of multi-part honor missions.

issues.topic: Chapter assignment of Icarus and Friends, A Fork in the Road, That's Murfree Country
issues.details: Icarus and Friends can be played before That's Murfree Country (i.e. during Chapter 5) but is filed under Chapter 6 in the replay menu. Fandom's flowchart treats A Fork in the Road / That's Murfree Country as leading into Chapter 6, while PowerPyx, Steam and GTABase list both under Chapter 5.

positions.claim: Fork in the Road and Murfree Country are Chapter 5; Icarus is Chapter 6
Icarus playable in Ch5 but counted as Ch6 on replay

issues.handling: Use the replay-menu grouping (Ch5: 9 missions incl. Fork & Murfree; Ch6: 19 incl. Icarus) and mention Icarus can be played early.

issues.details: Many Chapter 4 and 6 missions are branching/optional and can be done in different orders (fandom calculates millions of sequences). Chapter 5 'Savagery Unleashed' and 'A Kind and Benevolent Despot' can be done in either order (Steam/GTABase list Savagery first, PowerPyx lists Despot first).
issues.handling: orderInChapter is a typical order (GTABase/Steam), not mandatory; tell players to follow available markers.

issues.details: RDR2.org describes the ending as depending only on the final choice (money vs John). Fandom describes four variants: each choice has a high-honor and low-honor version. Neither affects trophies.

positions.claim: Ending depends entirely on the final choice
Four endings: choice x Arthur's honor level

issues.handling: Say the finale varies with both the choice and honor; no trophy depends on it.

issues.details: PowerPyx (patch 1.03 era) reports that replaying 'Home Improvement for Beginners' after the story unlocked 'Lending a Hand' even with missed honor missions; it may have been patched since.
issues.handling: Mention as an unverified fallback only; tell players to do every honor mission on the main playthrough.

issues.details: Fandom advises rapidly pressing the prompt; the Steam guide advises holding the button briefly for each nail. Requirement text (80% nail accuracy) is the same.
issues.handling: Present both tips.

issues.details: PowerPyx lists 18 'online trophies' including the Platinum; every other source lists 17 Red Dead Online trophies.
issues.handling: Show 17 online trophies; mention the Platinum separately.

issues.details: PowerPyx says 175,300 total XP; PSNProfiles says over 200,000; the Red Dead Wiki per-rank table adds up to ~176k.

positions.claim: about 176k when summing the per-rank table

issues.handling: Say 'roughly 175,000 XP' and tell players to check Pause > Progress > Rank Unlocks rather than quoting an exact number.

issues.topic: Gun For Hire: 10 missions or 10 different givers?
issues.details: PowerPyx and PSNProfiles say complete any 10 Free Roam missions; Gameplay.tips says 'from different quest givers'. The description says 'from characters around the world'.
issues.handling: Tell players to spread missions across different givers to be safe, and to check Awards > Free Roam.

issues.details: PSNProfiles marks it buggy: gold-bar purchases may not count and may break it for that character. TrueTrophies says it sometimes needs a 6th purchase. PowerPyx suggests buying all 5 flags in one menu visit.

positions.claim: Gold purchases may bug the trophy permanently for that character
Buy all 5 flags in one menu visit

issues.handling: Buy 5 flags with dollars, in one visit, before ever buying camp items with gold. If it fails, buy a 6th; as a last resort, reset the character.

issues.topic: Stall prices (Horses for Courses) and pamphlet ranks may be outdated
issues.details: The stall prices ($100/$150/$500/$750) and Rank 22/28 pamphlet ranks come from 2018-2019 guides. The TrueTrophies author notes the May 2019 update may have changed prices. No 2025-2026 source confirmed current values.

positions.claim: Stalls cost $1,500 total and horses $50 each

issues.handling: Present the prices as approximate; tell players to budget ~$1,700 and check the stable menu.

issues.topic: Posse Up when the set-up fee is waived
issues.details: Rockstar sometimes waives the $200 Persistent Posse fee. No source confirms whether the trophy still pops when the posse is created for free; the trophy trigger is forming the posse, so it should.

positions.claim: Fee waived in monthly events (e.g. Jun-Aug 2026)
Trophy pops on creating the Persistent Posse, fee $200

issues.handling: Say it normally costs $200 and may be free during events; creating any Persistent Posse is the trigger.

issues.topic: The Real Deal difficulty and methods in 2025-2026
issues.details: Older guides assumed full lobbies. 2025 posts say some playlists (e.g. Elimination) have thin lobbies and races are full of veterans, but territory modes still give MVPs for holding points. The TrueTrophies Call to Arms boost reportedly stopped working (Dec 2023). Boosting groups were still forming in Jan-Aug 2026.

positions.claim: Still obtainable solo via territory/flag modes or races (2025 reports)

issues.handling: Mark obtainable but lobby-dependent. Recommend territory-hold modes solo, or a 4-player boosting group in an empty playlist.

issues.topic: Study every animal and skin every species
issues.details: The Zoologist count is 152 in most sources but 165 in one. Skin Deep is quoted as 71, but the only full list names 70 (Northern Water Snake is the likely 71st). Whether Rufus and the Carolina Parakeet are required is disputed. If Skin Deep doesn't pop, also skin one of each livestock type (bull, ox, cow, pig, sheep, goat).

issues.details: One source summary says only grizzlies count and black bears don't; nothing else confirms or denies it. Farm grizzlies to be safe.
